subject: Walz Comes Our Way
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=1)

## Walz Comes Our Way, But Not Far Enough
### Tuesday, June 21st, 2022
Friend, Governor Tim Walz announced that he is willing to [sign a bill that would give back $1,000 of the surplus](https://www.action4liberty.com/walz_comes_our_way_on_giving_back_surplus_not_far_enough_though?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=2) to individuals and $2,000 to families. As you know, the government owes you over $4,000 back! Walz isn't going far enough! To make matters worse, Walz likely wants to give the money to everyone, including non-taxpaying Minnesotans. Which is a massive wealth distribution program that we can't get behind. But he is at least coming our way. Senate Republicans who tentatively agreed to spend the majority of the surplus with Walz, have now backed off of agreeing to the details of large spending bills. Good! However, instead of returning the surplus to Minnesotans during rising costs of consumer goods, the Senate proposed long term tax cuts. They need to GIVE IT BACK immediately. The Legislature adjourned for the year already. In order for the surplus to be returned, Governor Walz would have to call a Special Session. Action 4 Liberty opposes a Special Session unless it is to GIVE BACK the entire surplus. Republicans in the Senate have the ultimate chips in their hands: either get Walz to agree to give it all back or let voters decide who should be in control of the government this November. **Watch our recent video about how Action 4 Liberty supporters like you helped kill the Special Session:** [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZ9sudaQYCMNFZHfoh2cugb&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=3)
## [WATCH NOW](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZ9sudaQYCMNFZHfoh2cugb&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=4)
Listen, if Tim Walz doesn't come all the way to our side and GIVE BACK ALL the surplus, then we'll make sure to [let all the state fairgoers](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=5) know that Tim Walz REFUSES to help them while gas and food prices continue to rise.
## **Jake Duesenberg**
**Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=6 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=6)

You can also keep up with Jake Duesenberg on [Facebook](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nyVoJL5zCIi1gu8lCoYmQrA8P7rhuOjJmdy-IRmglie&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=walz_comes_our_way&n=8).

name: Charles Booker
subject: One of the hardest things I've done.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Content Warning: This email and the video below contain graphic references
to lynching and racial violence.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter, over the
weekend, we honored Juneteenth — a celebration of how far we’ve come and a
reminder of the fight for freedom and independence.

While there is much to celebrate, there can be no true celebration of
Juneteenth without acknowledging that the deep devastation of slavery and
structural racism has never fully met justice. It is time that we all come
together and reconcile this painful truth.

That’s why earlier this month, I posted a video about the family members
I’ve lost to lynching. I spoke about the hate and division holding us back
as a country, and why replacing Rand Paul is so critical in our fight for
healing, humanity, and a brighter future.

Some people told me this video would be controversial. Too jarring.

This video was one of the hardest things I have done, but after a lot of
prayer and reflection, I knew this video was an important message in
confronting the trauma of our history.

You see, I’ve had ancestors who were enslaved in Kentucky. Family members
who fought for desegregation in Kentucky. Three of my uncles were lynched
in Kentucky. And I know I’m not alone: there are millions of families in
Kentucky and throughout the South who share this story.

So when Rand Paul single-handedly voted to block the Emmett Till Anti-
Lynching Act two years ago — legislation that would finally make lynching
a federal hate crime — I took that personally. This is also the man who
said he would have voted against the Civil Rights Act – the man that
compared expanded health care to slavery.

I know this video will be challenging to watch. I understand the
sensitivity of this issue, and realize the visual will expose some wounds
that have not healed up in our society.

My hope is that by watching this video, folks will understand just how
important this campaign is in our broader mission to realize true freedom,
peace, justice, and democracy.

I hope it will challenge all of us to mobilize and come together in the
work to uproot hate, which includes defeating Rand Paul this year.

You can [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18292?t=1001&akid=2102%2E346206%2EvzfruE ]click here to watch the video:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18350?t=1002&akid=2102%2E346206%2EvzfruE ][IMG]
With love,

Charles

P.S. Thank you for all of your support,
Peter. You’ve already helped us
make history by making me the first Black Kentuckian to receive the
Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Together, I know we can continue
moving mountains.

If you’re finished watching the video and want to show your support for
our movement, [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220621.cNmXgk&refcode=em20220621-other-2102-2&t=1003&akid=2102%2E346206%2EvzfruE ]will you chip in $5 or anything you can to
our grassroots funded campaign? It’s going to take all of us working
together to end Rand’s corporate-funded, failed campaign and usher in a
new era of people-first leadership to Kentucky.

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20220621-2102-footer&t=1004&refcode2=2102_346206_vzfruE&akid=2102%2E346206%2EvzfruE

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2102%2E346206%2EvzfruE

Contributions to Booker for Kentucky are not deductible for federal income tax purposes.

# Calling all volunteers! Help us GOTV!
We have one week left to make a difference. Let's make it count.

We've got a lot of ways you can get involved, so let's get right to it. **Text with Team Cole**! We'll be texting **Wednesday - Friday from 6-8pm + a bonus GOTV textbank on Monday night (6/27)**. [Sign up here](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=53929d89bc&e=339f142c50). All textbanks are virtual!

**On Saturday & Sunday, we canvass**. We'll host a [city](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=c61a16180c&e=339f142c50) and [suburban](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=9ee347d25b&e=339f142c50) canvass from 1-3pm. On Tuesday, we will have Team Cole at the polls! [Sign up with this google form](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=59f8511e03&e=339f142c50) to work the polls, talking to voters and passing out literature before they vote. Thank you for spending the past 15 months on this journey with me. If you can't make it out into the field, please **talk to your friends and neighbors about voting** , and [make a donation](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=1c0f6f70bd&e=339f142c50) if you can! We need all the support we can get in this last week.

Yours in service,

Jahmal Cole

Our Children Deserve Safe Schools

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b8e07ecd9b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_22_01_54&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b8e07ecd9b-584862049

** Under the Lopez Administration,
------------------------------------------------------------

** Schools Will Be Safe!
------------------------------------------------------------

** As your next Governor, school security will be a top priority.

------------------------------------------------------------

The Heritage Foundation provides 4 pillars of school security in “Here’s How School Security Should Be Improved in 4 Easy Steps (https://www.heritage.org/education/commentary/heres-how-school-security-should-be-improved-4-easy-steps?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b8e07ecd9b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_22_01_54&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b8e07ecd9b-584862049) ”

1. Pre-emptive Response

School administrators must respond to threats on social media or overheard in conversations.
“The students will be your best source of information. This generation of young people lives in near-constant communication, but it is not always transparent to the staff and faculty. Given that there were warning signs before almost all of the recent school shootings (many of which were stopped), making the students a part of this process is a key. That said, these warning signs must provoke immediate action. The majority of the shooters have had some mental health or social interaction issues, and people noticed.”

2. Access Control

“The second pillar is firmly controlling access to school facilities. If a person does not belong in the school, or is attempting to bring in prohibited items such as weapons, they must be denied access. Schools must have limited points of entry (one or at most two), each of which should be monitored and controlled by personnel that can turn people away when needed.”

3. Hardening Classrooms

“All classroom doors have windows to allow observation (and protection for the children), but in an active shooter situation, this becomes a liability. There needs to be a low-cost, fast way of blocking the outside view through the window. Likewise, the doors must be lockable from the inside by the door’s organic lock, and with some sort of very simple, quickly applied additional blocking mechanism. Within the classroom, teachers must be able to provide their students both cover (protection from gunfire) and concealment (a place to hide).”

4. On-Site Incident Response

“There are four main options. (1) A school can have dedicated police assets on campus; (2) they can hire private security personnel; (3) they can seek volunteer security personnel from the community (such as veterans or retired law enforcement); or (4) they can have armed staff and/or faculty. There are numerous options for schools to attain this on-site capability, and communities must choose what they can support, both budget-wise and within their collective moral structures.”

As your next Governor, I plan to meet with local law enforcement and school district administrators to develop best practices on school security in Colorado. Become a part of our team to recapture Colorado for our families and our children!

Greg Lopez

clean_body: Our Children Deserve Safe Schools Under the Lopez Administration, Schools Will Be Safe! As your next Governor, school security will be a top priority. The Heritage Foundation provides 4 pillars of school security in “Here’s How School Security Should Be Improved in 4 Easy Steps () ” 1. Pre-emptive Response School administrators must respond to threats on social media or overheard in conversations. “The students will be your best source of information. This generation of young people lives in near-constant communication, but it is not always transparent to the staff and faculty. Given that there were warning signs before almost all of the recent school shootings (many of which were stopped), making the students a part of this process is a key. That said, these warning signs must provoke immediate action. The majority of the shooters have had some mental health or social interaction issues, and people noticed.” 2. Access Control “The second pillar is firmly controlling access to school facilities. If a person does not belong in the school, or is attempting to bring in prohibited items such as weapons, they must be denied access. Schools must have limited points of entry (one or at most two), each of which should be monitored and controlled by personnel that can turn people away when needed.” 3. Hardening Classrooms “All classroom doors have windows to allow observation (and protection for the children), but in an active shooter situation, this becomes a liability. There needs to be a low-cost, fast way of blocking the outside view through the window. Likewise, the doors must be lockable from the inside by the door’s organic lock, and with some sort of very simple, quickly applied additional blocking mechanism. Within the classroom, teachers must be able to provide their students both cover (protection from gunfire) and concealment (a place to hide).” 4. On-Site Incident Response “There are four main options. (1) A school can have dedicated police assets on campus; (2) they can hire private security personnel; (3) they can seek volunteer security personnel from the community (such as veterans or retired law enforcement); or (4) they can have armed staff and/or faculty. There are numerous options for schools to attain this on-site capability, and communities must choose what they can support, both budget-wise and within their collective moral structures.” As your next Governor, I plan to meet with local law enforcement and school district administrators to develop best practices on school security in Colorado. name: Karen Dabney
subject: This is more than we can handle on our own
body:
I'm writing to you as a last resort. Because right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8cq7ofqdmgpcv5bp6seem20v1ul86fk0n8fmrjo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onjc2o72dj6e1ir6s5iecr36tj6m1ij6plge9gb4p3hcdj3dd73mdi7cphkcmr3eduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmmq60tr2coq61cr56uobapbi4no)
Friend,

I'm writing to you as a last resort.

Because right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own.

This is a photo of me with my son, former Deputy James Johnson of the Williamson County, TX Sheriff's Department.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8nvqu6inm936b1dcg8l79sbhj3orcb0n9npdl5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b9oni18549fg)

James dreamed of being a police officer ever since he took his first "ride-along" in a cop car at the age of 18.

How could we ever know, back then, that one day he would find himself the target of a nationwide political movement directed and financed by billionaire George Soros?

But crazy as it sounds, that's exactly what's happening to him!

[**_And if I had any other options, I wouldn't have to for your help today to save my son from this legal nightmare. _**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkr2dq3aep8203kjsqb2bsmglql0gr14gqrjd9mo_rp2ash2s8gt7c5he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1mkor2cpnkor60p3563hmap73cjjm6o76cjh64d9icpjuasblmvb7fdbieoqjbogh2saq4l8jicin2tdnqmqj2d5lemqua5cj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprboj0c9h60or2c9jt448n2v8pa4ch2cbt250i2eah9luiak9pfk2k2mjhf42ga8gq48bi4bh28or5clge9oj0c9jm49fg)
On the night of March 28, 2019, my son conducted a routine traffic stop.

But instead of pulling over, the driver -- a convicted drug dealer named Javier Ambler -- floored the gas and tried to flee.

Ambler's speed quickly exceeded 100 miles per hour. Along the way, he collided with signs, trees, fences, and other roadside objects.

The chase lasted for 22 minutes and spanned two counties. At any moment, another driver or a pedestrian could have been struck and killed by Ambler's reckless driving. It was a deadly serious situation.

Eventually, the chase ended when Ambler crashed head-first into a tree.

My son ordered him to get on the ground at gunpoint. Ambler refused. James ordered again, and still the driver did not comply.

That's when another Deputy and an Austin Police Officer arrived on scene. Together, they tried to handcuff the giant man -- but he kept resisting and fighting to get back on his feet.

Now, my son is strong. . . but this man was twice his size. . . **nearly 400 pounds**. And even together, the three officers could not subdue him.

So, to put a stop to his fighting and get him handcuffed, they deployed a taser again.

Still nothing -- he kept resisting.

They tased him once more and they were finally able to get him into handcuffs.

That's when they noticed that Ambler had lost consciousness. Without missing a beat, they immediately began life-saving tactics and radioed for an ambulance to respond with high priority.

Ambler was rushed to the hospital -- but despite the prompt medical attention, he was declared dead on arrival.

According to the medical examiner, Ambler's "morbid obesity" had given him "congestive heart failure" and "hyper intensive cardiovascular disease,"" which, in the heat of the struggle, caused his death.

Soon after, an internal affairs investigation by my son's department found that the deputies did nothing wrong, and a second independent investigation by the Austin Police Department concluded my son and the other officers committed no such crimes and did not cause Ambler's death.

**But two years after being cleared, my son was charged with manslaughter!**

So what changed all of a sudden?

Well, Travis County -- where Ambler crashed and the chase concluded -- elected a new District Attorney.

A George Soros-funded District Attorney . . . a Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren-endorsed District Attorney . . . a socialist District Attorney, who campaigned not on fighting crime -- but on cracking down on police.

His name is Jose Garza, and in just over a year in office, he's charged dozens of cops with crimes while letting countless violent criminals go free!

He's spent tens of millions of dollars (and over a half million in this race alone) installing progressive prosecutors who will be soft on crime and tough on cops.

Somehow, my son James got caught up in something much bigger than himself, and now he's lost his job and his life savings trying to defend his good name in court.

[**_If you have the means, will you please help my son stay out of prison by helping him afford the mountain of legal fees in front of him?_**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8mh015ebrmc2f6t979t1q7dt0i45a1lps1v6eho_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b9oni18549fg)

Thankfully -- right as we thought all hope was lost -- we got a call from the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

This incredible organization helps innocent cops who are unfairly prosecuted for split-second, life-or-death decisions they make in the line of duty.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses. . . whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court.

And they do it all free of charge!

They're funded entirely by the generous support of big-hearted donors like you, who can recognize a miscarriage of justice. . . and want to help fix it.

So now I must ask you the question I've been afraid to ask this entire letter:

[Will you please help my son James win his court case and clear his name by sending LELDF the best tax-deductible contribution you can afford today?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zutre9kdc9m2qlc2b98ljv4skojnl3dj0ho3g0d0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b9oni18549fg)

Most friends of LELDF sent one-time donations of [$35 or $50](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zth7bhtouut2m46mcemsejgd2v9nn8gp4lj5qt9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b9oni18549fg).

Whatever you can spare today, I hope you'll know how grateful I -- and my entire family -- will be for your help.

With deep appreciation,

**Karen Dabney**

P.S. my son has four children of his own. His youngest is only 7 years old. If James is convicted and receives the maximum sentence of 20 years, they'll be grown adults by the time he's finally set free.

So please -- PLEASE -- won't you send the best donation you can spare today to help keep my brave son out of prison and with his children, where he belongs? Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!

To make your tax-deductible contribution, please follow this secure link: [_https://secure.anedot.com/leldf/c5784fed7ce3104ea183a_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfu5t8r7i12b5uad1me4ekkurt56s24nd399e9k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b9oni18549fg)
\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we’re defending, please visit**www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z396kiihohpip8st7muvhgo6c6fhqgi573j97gjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ie4o32cth2bs)
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303

_

625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

name: Karen Dabney
subject: The call that gave us hope again
body:
I'm writing to you as a last resort. Because right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znbbgobsiupf5501t6j7nehqofn118m9ubbcina8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbr64t3ks5gjccj4ehr30pdim8obeobmc2r65dbkcooe8pj463irepb66qqj2sj0sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6lj3cp5l6grr4sb664ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clim1p75cdi66oh5u)
Friend,

I'm writing to you as a last resort.

Because right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own.

This is a photo of me with my son, former Deputy James Johnson of the Williamson County, TX Sheriff's Department.

[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmlgfqano8m5gbhte01h182ku5gojn7sl6oadfb0_rp2ash2s8gt7c5he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1mkor2cpnkor60p3563hmap73cjjm6o76cjh64d9icpjuasblmvb7fdbieoqjbogh2saq4l8jicin2tdnqmqj2d5lemqua5cj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprboj0c9h60or2c9jt448n2v8pa4ch2cbt250i2eah9luiak9pfk2k2mgl2ksi46h22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh2bs)

James dreamed of being a police officer ever since he took his first "ride-along" in a cop car at the age of 18.

How could we ever know, back then, that one day he would find himself the target of a nationwide political movement directed and financed by billionaire George Soros?

But crazy as it sounds, that's exactly what's happening to him!

[**_And if I had any other options, I wouldn't have to for your help today to save my son from this legal nightmare. _**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zaj5k3bdv53nb3fgcaj5psutr9ag5c8hi2332v1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b8ahae92bs)
On the night of March 28, 2019, my son conducted a routine traffic stop.

But instead of pulling over, the driver -- a convicted drug dealer named Javier Ambler -- floored the gas and tried to flee.

Ambler's speed quickly exceeded 100 miles per hour. Along the way, he collided with signs, trees, fences, and other roadside objects.

The chase lasted for 22 minutes and spanned two counties. At any moment, another driver or a pedestrian could have been struck and killed by Ambler's reckless driving. It was a deadly serious situation.

Eventually, the chase ended when Ambler crashed head-first into a tree.

My son ordered him to get on the ground at gunpoint. Ambler refused. James ordered again, and still the driver did not comply.

That's when another Deputy and an Austin Police Officer arrived on scene. Together, they tried to handcuff the giant man -- but he kept resisting and fighting to get back on his feet.

Now, my son is strong. . . but this man was twice his size. . . **nearly 400 pounds**. And even together, the three officers could not subdue him.

So, to put a stop to his fighting and get him handcuffed, they deployed a taser again.

Still nothing -- he kept resisting.

They tased him once more and they were finally able to get him into handcuffs.

That's when they noticed that Ambler had lost consciousness. Without missing a beat, they immediately began life-saving tactics and radioed for an ambulance to respond with high priority.

Ambler was rushed to the hospital -- but despite the prompt medical attention, he was declared dead on arrival.

According to the medical examiner, Ambler's "morbid obesity" had given him "congestive heart failure" and "hyper intensive cardiovascular disease,"" which, in the heat of the struggle, caused his death.

Soon after, an internal affairs investigation by my son's department found that the deputies did nothing wrong, and a second independent investigation by the Austin Police Department concluded my son and the other officers committed no such crimes and did not cause Ambler's death.

**But two years after being cleared, my son was charged with manslaughter!**

So what changed all of a sudden?

Well, Travis County -- where Ambler crashed and the chase concluded -- elected a new District Attorney.

A George Soros-funded District Attorney . . . a Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren-endorsed District Attorney . . . a socialist District Attorney, who campaigned not on fighting crime -- but on cracking down on police.

His name is Jose Garza, and in just over a year in office, he's charged dozens of cops with crimes while letting countless violent criminals go free!

He's spent tens of millions of dollars (and over a half million in this race alone) installing progressive prosecutors who will be soft on crime and tough on cops.

Somehow, my son James got caught up in something much bigger than himself, and now he's lost his job and his life savings trying to defend his good name in court.

[**_If you have the means, will you please help my son stay out of prison by helping him afford the mountain of legal fees in front of him?_**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziadjn3nmq2mt7u8e61cl43q62bp0plp1np8dp38_rp2ash2s8gt7c5he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1mkor2cpnkor60p3563hmap73cjjm6o76cjh64d9icpjuasblmvb7fdbieoqjbogh2saq4l8jicin2tdnqmqj2d5lemqua5cj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprboj0c9h60or2c9jt448n2v8pa4ch2cbt250i2eah9luiak9pfk2k2mgl2ksi46h22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh2bs)

Thankfully -- right as we thought all hope was lost -- we got a call from the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

This incredible organization helps innocent cops who are unfairly prosecuted for split-second, life-or-death decisions they make in the line of duty.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses. . . whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court.

And they do it all free of charge!

They're funded entirely by the generous support of big-hearted donors like you, who can recognize a miscarriage of justice. . . and want to help fix it.

So now I must ask you the question I've been afraid to ask this entire letter:

[Will you please help my son James win his court case and clear his name by sending LELDF the best tax-deductible contribution you can afford today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zum20d7vq8bmg7bfqntohf491h6lbmj3697k4ceo_rp2ash2s8gt7c5he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1mkor2cpnkor60p3563hmap73cjjm6o76cjh64d9icpjuasblmvb7fdbieoqjbogh2saq4l8jicin2tdnqmqj2d5lemqua5cj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprboj0c9h60or2c9jt448n2v8pa4ch2cbt250i2eah9luiak9pfk2k2mgl2ksi46h22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh2bs)

Most friends of LELDF sent one-time donations of [$35 or $50](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjbhhcm9n261nl76dpncht3pgi6vr6p1l3fifgo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh238h5e8he48ejm2on2s3mebjqf9jl6oqn4t9jkgprac9nm5pqcdtlmugracdh6crqcdj0chij1or5cjhm9pr3c3j69oj26kp6cpv5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls88he5d2ak9p69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf52m9iasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64oj0cdh64pui24bhfkcl268h65uh2g91758kqv95a4snq1a1b8ahae92bs).

Whatever you can spare today, I hope you'll know how grateful I -- and my entire family -- will be for your help.

With deep appreciation,

**Karen Dabney**

P.S. my son has four children of his own. His youngest is only 7 years old. If James is convicted and receives the maximum sentence of 20 years, they'll be grown adults by the time he's finally set free.

So please -- PLEASE -- won't you send the best donation you can spare today to help keep my brave son out of prison and with his children, where he belongs? Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!

To make your tax-deductible contribution, please follow this secure link: [_https://secure.anedot.com/leldf/c5784fed7ce3104ea183a_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfvgbfdgavls5mq0ntvm3nheop9hpun6trim51p8_rp2ash2s8gt7c5he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1mkor2cpnkor60p3563hmap73cjjm6o76cjh64d9icpjuasblmvb7fdbieoqjbogh2saq4l8jicin2tdnqmqj2d5lemqua5cj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprboj0c9h60or2c9jt448n2v8pa4ch2cbt250i2eah9luiak9pfk2k2mgl2ksi46h22sh2s8i66pb5c3ieaor4cdh2bs)
\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we’re defending, please visit**www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

It speaks to a frightening lack of empathy for others—that, or a willful ignorance rooted in maintaining some perceived political advantage. Either way, it is condemnable and completely unacceptable. Take, for example, [this exchange between a 14 year old testifying against yet another in a long series of anti-trans "bathroom bills" and a Missouri legislator](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46810939/351876291/-1446552050?s=20&t=6loORDsz4MEHCCUuzXWrEg&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAzMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZDk3NDczZi0zMWYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=epfxqduWNcyl_XVkgX0bX6O1BMS1W8o16N-rbEDFfIM=&emci=9586010e-70f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd97473f-31f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14943357) whose questioning exemplifies the unwillingness to understand or empathize with LGBTQ+ individuals: MO Legislator: _"Are you going to have the procedure?"_ Youth: _"You think we're going around forcing our genitalia in people's faces. We're trying to go to the bathroom."_ Parent: _"You're asking a 14-year-old on public record about genitals...[i]t's frankly inappropriate." _ These transphobic legislators are interrogating our courageous LGBTQ+ youth about their genitals, forcing them to come forward and explain why they are not a threat to hypothetical strangers in bathrooms. What do they think gives them the right? This bigotry must be condemned and opposed as strongly as possible.
* * *
Listen, I know the last thing we want to think about is elections, much less a candidate reaching out asking for contributions. But the truth is, if allies like myself are going to be in positions of power and influence to fight back against anti-LGBTQ+ discrimination, we need to run the strongest campaigns possible. clean_body: Peter, Reflecting on the state of LGBTQ+ rights during this Pride Month, I still find myself unable to understand why folks like Ann Wagner on the Right simply cannot accept people for who they are. It speaks to a frightening lack of empathy for others—that, or a willful ignorance rooted in maintaining some perceived political advantage. Either way, it is condemnable and completely unacceptable. Take, for example, whose questioning exemplifies the unwillingness to understand or empathize with LGBTQ+ individuals: MO Legislator: "Are you going to have the procedure?" Youth: "You think we're going around forcing our genitalia in people's faces. We're trying to go to the bathroom." Parent: "You're asking a 14-year-old on public record about genitals...[i]t's frankly inappropriate." These transphobic legislators are interrogating our courageous LGBTQ+ youth about their genitals, forcing them to come forward and explain why they are not a threat to hypothetical strangers in bathrooms. What do they think gives them the right? This bigotry must be condemned and opposed as strongly as possible. Listen, I know the last thing we want to think about is elections, much less a candidate reaching out asking for contributions. Team,
It’s been a busy few months getting to know Michigan’s new 7th District. It’s a pretty unique place, and Elissa has been out visiting local businesses, hosting “friend-raisers,” and even partaking in some fried gizzard at Gizzard Fest in Potterville!
We’ll cut straight to the point. As we approach the critical final months of the campaign, we’re looking to scale our operation even further. And with our end-of-quarter deadline coming up on June 30th, we’re asking if you will chip in $7 to help Elissa meet more of the new 7th district. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220622&amount=7]
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220622&amount=7 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220622&amount=7]
We’ve got the whole summer ahead of us, which means parades, festivals, local events, and so much more – and Team Slotkin is looking to have a presence at everything we possibly can. But it’s more than just showing up, it’s being prepared.
That means bringing along yard signs, bumper stickers, buttons, and t-shirts. It means bringing along information about Elissa’s background for those who may not know her, voter registration forms, and ways to volunteer. AND since Elissa can’t be everywhere at once (trust us, she’s tried) it means hiring more field organizers and fellows to help us reach even more voters.
A key part of showing up prepared is having the resources to do so – and this is the biggest district Elissa has ever run in. We’ll be honest, we need more resources than we ever have to show up districtwide.
Our end-of-quarter deadline is coming up on June 30th, and it’s a great time to show that we are prepared and are ready for anything the next few months will throw at us. Will you chip in $7 for the new $7th district today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220622&amount=7]

"I am honored the voters of Virginia's 7th Congressional District have chosen me to be the Republican nominee in the general election this fall. As the first conservative Hispanic to win a republican congressional primary in Virginia, this is a historic moment for Hispanics across Virginia and our nation. I want to thank my family, friends, volunteers, and all the voters who believe in our message of liberty, safety, and economic prosperity," Yesli Vega
---
|
---
Dear Friends:
If you have not heard the news, last night was a historic first with Virginia 7th Congressional District Republicans selecting Prince William County Supervisor [Yesli Vega](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsEmXe9irMicG_GSN1037cCAZBL5lKwYWRNK3JUUKuS2b4f3_6wAdPuYD64w5ffto88u6g5Gy6hld4=&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==) as their candidate to challenge progressive Democrat Abigail Spanberger. The 7th District covers the Eastern half of Prince William County while the Western end of PWC is in our 10th CD with another great candidate, [Hung Cao](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsEPQjVkfnExSjNVwCHrIBw0mKH4hobkjaH3p9HMKOEloLeqaz6Qfcv-ZvStSvRrjdgGfOEIGWocViRp1FptAGeX71IE5zQblfp&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==). Congratulations to Yesli, and again to Hung, for their success in the Republican nomination process.
And now on to win in November!
As our Nation grows more diverse, our engagement with minority communities is paramount to turn the country around from the progressive socialist direction the Democrats are pushing. Diverse communities share our conservative values but the GOP has had a challenge connecting with minority voters.
I am enthusiastic to join with my good friend and the former Prince William County Republican Chairman, Tim Parrish, in support of his new organization dedicated to diverse engagement - [Right Appeal PAC](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsE0WiLevlW_rlwWZ4KDGBnjC-aB8QvMde-OCSfui4bgjhOp35cwHKZjgx7BRzP3MZg18JG1StCdejt3KQHMHYlgw==&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==).
You can read more about the goals of Right Appeal below and on the website [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsE0WiLevlW_rlwWZ4KDGBnjC-aB8QvMde-OCSfui4bgjhOp35cwHKZjgx7BRzP3MZg18JG1StCdejt3KQHMHYlgw==&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==). I hope you will also join me in [donating here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsEAEii3PBBOOIhhj5G_SmmByHNALkjZ9kQ3dCt_mvr7doc1-hWVirC1t_kPcsboR8X7SMJCmGnFfqb4_QrK119Z2Y15YgwIMe6NxSfRJwKu_TthQQeT2PXO2NfMrPxxSJjKYfM37mfhRaZQKQXhrjScg==&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==) to help Right Appeal expand their conservative engagement programs in our diverse communities.
Thank you again for all the support you provided to me in my campaign this Spring and I am truly excited about our ability to win numerous congressional seats this Fall and flip to a sensible Republican majority in the House and Senate.
May God Bless, Caleb
P.S. On Thursday for Right Appeal is holding a special fundraiser in Old Town Alexandria with Dr. Sebastian Gorka ([details here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014MLCXECl2lZwaUuDjfHAdw9moS5EgYNnmmxwiLWfpcmOheWzD-gQaxC7SbVzyEsEs4fjMIxhBhe0BrTdVjKYznkmZqbqkN8jCYwTZcAMaBFxX4hdMqKc5t75YLVJKJl1T9HY1DWR5X31CcNKECwqyvoqqXs4bQQwBHrkPTF6pk36_DjzeQY56rpoypOdLdyliD7wqWdwT1vB6-Xw7nAqPAlqphPE22dWdG9P5IZWAnk=&c=7QyRAlMCCkVQ8ykJ5SQLIUcEDOYO0P_H-SPH4pTl2N3_wAUdOxTHiQ==&ch=KTLX3Q2TnuZoNEKTuZ3DzSs7oJGMPOvVfHYpK94ZD2fqT_EDSn21yQ==)). If you enjoy a good cigar and conversation, I hope you will join us for this event. And save the date of Monday, July 25th evening for a soon to be announced RA fundraiser. Thanks.

Gary Grasso criticized his opponent for what he calls “a blatant distortion of the facts” ahead of the June 28th primary. [http://email.mail.electoraladvantage.com/c/eJxtjjtPxDAQhH9NXEb2-hGucHFCHMXxaiigQXte27HkPIjDHcevx6FGWmlWmp3Zz30ksnc_vn__ll_d8SSv9_p2fV0eWZ7c5j0_Xd4e1HI-ypjD58t1Pqx7RlaAJhFYssABuAEQgmsObQdEEjH4gIEbZxrFB0y59dm7dVowI51xXDH61k0D663ZdciNgJ1E4koI3UFw7uSVFEAoPMu2X9e5NHLfwKFO2WpqPE5TzB7nVLamagwllpGWuv3HvB14SljVwI0CFYiTVlpJ8NQpp4Rs5zGyxdJ8STmnYroKH__o64NfGTRelA]

GRASSO ACCUSES PEKAU OF BLATANTLY DISTORTING HIS OWN RECORD TO DECEIVE VOTERS
6th Congressional District candidate and Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso criticized his opponent for what he calls “a blatant
distortion of the facts” ahead of the June 28th primary. Grasso is specifically challenging his opponent, Orland Park Mayor Keith
Pekau, on deceiving voters about Pekau’s salary and pension as mayor and property taxes in Orland Park.

“If you compare what he says against the record, it is clear my opponent is blatantly distorting facts in an effort to deceive
voters,” stated Grasso. “Pekau has been lying about the salary prior to being elected mayor promising to do one thing only to do
another after he is elected. I think voters deserve to know the truth about his campaign distortions and frankly about him before
they cast their vote on June 28th.”

Pekau and his campaign are sending mailers, emails, videos, and speeches to tout false claims such as: “I (Pekau) lowered my own
salary by 70% and I took away pensions for elected officials.” His deception started in 2017 when he vigorously campaigned against
the $150,000+ mayor’s salary yet pocketed the salary when sworn in after the election. It is well documented that Pekau chose to
take the full $150,000 after saying he was against it, deceiving Orland voters who voted for him.

“When my opponent won his election, he kept the mayor’s salary for four years totaling over $600,000. Midway through his term, his
duties were cut to part time at the same rate of pay and made it pensionable – a further hidden benefit for him. So, Pekau
deceived the voters by promising one thing and doing another and he is deceiving them again now,” added Grasso.

Under the 2016 village ordinance, the Orland Park Board of Trustees provided for the $150,000 mayor’s salary to “sunset”
automatically back to what it was in 2016 if they did not extend it. No vote to lower the salary was ever taken by the Village
Board. Pekau’s claims that he cut his salary by 70% are blatantly false and misleading – the salary was lowered automatically by
Village ordinance.

“Keith Pekau tells unsuspecting voters that he removed all the pensions for elected officials – leaving out one important fact: he
and the board kept his position pension eligible,” Grasso contends. “Pekau voted in favor of keeping himself pension eligible by a
5 to 2 vote.”

Grasso’s campaign also takes issue with Pekau’s claims he lowered property taxes by 28% in Orland Park. Like many municipalities,
schools account for the largest portion of property taxes upwards of 70% with the remaining taxes levied for county, pensions, and
other taxing bodies.

Property taxes in villages like Orland Park are traditionally 5% to 6% of a total tax bill. Pekau has once again claimed in
mailers, emails, videos, and speeches that he lowered property taxes by as much as 30% which is false. In fact, he increased the
tax levy (the amount of money the village wants from taxes), and Orland is taking in more money today than when he began as mayor
therefore increasing property taxes since he took office.

“It is disingenuous to tell voters district-wide that you lowered property taxes in Orland Park by nearly 30% when you only
control 5% - 6% of a total property tax bill,” explained Grasso. “It seems to establish a pattern of false claims misleading
voters at a time when trust in our government is at an all-time low. Look, the residents of the 6th district deserve honest

[] GRASSO ACCUSES PEKAU OF BLATANTLY DISTORTING HIS OWN RECORD TO DECEIVE VOTERS 6th Congressional District candidate and Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso criticized his opponent for what he calls “a blatant distortion of the facts” ahead of the June 28th primary. Grasso is specifically challenging his opponent, Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, on deceiving voters about Pekau’s salary and pension as mayor and property taxes in Orland Park. “If you compare what he says against the record, it is clear my opponent is blatantly distorting facts in an effort to deceive voters,” stated Grasso. “Pekau has been lying about the salary prior to being elected mayor promising to do one thing only to do another after he is elected. I think voters deserve to know the truth about his campaign distortions and frankly about him before they cast their vote on June 28th.” Pekau and his campaign are sending mailers, emails, videos, and speeches to tout false claims such as: “I (Pekau) lowered my own salary by 70% and I took away pensions for elected officials.” His deception started in 2017 when he vigorously campaigned against the $150,000+ mayor’s salary yet pocketed the salary when sworn in after the election. It is well documented that Pekau chose to take the full $150,000 after saying he was against it, deceiving Orland voters who voted for him. “When my opponent won his election, he kept the mayor’s salary for four years totaling over $600,000. Midway through his term, his duties were cut to part time at the same rate of pay and made it pensionable – a further hidden benefit for him. So, Pekau deceived the voters by promising one thing and doing another and he is deceiving them again now,” added Grasso. Under the 2016 village ordinance, the Orland Park Board of Trustees provided for the $150,000 mayor’s salary to “sunset” automatically back to what it was in 2016 if they did not extend it. No vote to lower the salary was ever taken by the Village Board. Pekau’s claims that he cut his salary by 70% are blatantly false and misleading – the salary was lowered automatically by Village ordinance. “Keith Pekau tells unsuspecting voters that he removed all the pensions for elected officials – leaving out one important fact: he and the board kept his position pension eligible,” Grasso contends. “Pekau voted in favor of keeping himself pension eligible by a 5 to 2 vote.” Grasso’s campaign also takes issue with Pekau’s claims he lowered property taxes by 28% in Orland Park. Like many municipalities, schools account for the largest portion of property taxes upwards of 70% with the remaining taxes levied for county, pensions, and other taxing bodies. Property taxes in villages like Orland Park are traditionally 5% to 6% of a total tax bill. Pekau has once again claimed in mailers, emails, videos, and speeches that he lowered property taxes by as much as 30% which is false. In fact, he increased the tax levy (the amount of money the village wants from taxes), and Orland is taking in more money today than when he began as mayor therefore increasing property taxes since he took office. “It is disingenuous to tell voters district-wide that you lowered property taxes in Orland Park by nearly 30% when you only control 5% - 6% of a total property tax bill,” explained Grasso. “It seems to establish a pattern of false claims misleading voters at a time when trust in our government is at an all-time low. Look, the residents of the 6th district deserve honest representation in Congress and that is what they will get from me.” Request a yard sign! Peter,

Every New Mexican should have the opportunity to access higher education, no matter their family's income. That's why I signed a law to provide tuition-free college for every student – and I just had the honor of meeting one of them.
Carla was inspired to go to nursing school after seeing how nurses took such great care of her parents in their final hours, but she didn't know where she could find the money to pay for tuition. **Because of my administration's Opportunity Scholarship, she's working to achieve her dream and care for her community.**
This time of year, you're probably starting to get bombarded with TV attack ads, urgent polling news, and political strategy messages, so I know it can be easy to forget what this is really about. The truth is, our grassroots movement is _changing New Mexican lives_ – and I was only able to support students like Carla because people like you contributed to my campaign.

**Since you're a key part of this grassroots movement, I want you to understand your incredible impact on the people of New Mexico: Will you take a second to listen to Carla's story?**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46818799/351908236/707745822?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1325-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzZjODNiNC0zY2YyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wN36H9y8z5JZrsxSrt_lbJn0TROPDXGW_cj_ObWuh3U=)
This is just one story out of thousands of students like Carla – future nurses, teachers, and innovators who lacked the funding to pay for college. Because of our work, these students are able to achieve their career dreams and give back to our great state.
I can't thank you enough for supporting this campaign. Together, we're changing lives – one policy, one program, and one action at a time.

Michelle Lujan Grisham

Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty-like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author-C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://trk.readactnews.)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://trk.readactnews.)," **we've received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis' writings. | Dear Friend,
The amount of hypocrisy and misinformation out there these days is simply stunning.
Here are three examples, just from today:

* The Mass. Supreme Judicial Court decided that it is okay for a ballot question for a graduated income tax to include a summary saying that revenue will be used for education and transportation. I've seen first-hand the games the Legislature plays with your money, and I can tell you this -- Democrats will stop at nothing to spend any extra tax revenue they collect, any way they see fit.

* There's a new poll out today from the UMass Center for Public Opinion Polls. The liberal media is spinning the poll in favor of Maura Healey. But, there's a big problem -- the poll actually tells nothing about the state of the race for Governor, because it inexplicably never asked voters which candidate they favor in either the Democrat or Republican primaries.

* President Biden reportedly will call today for the federal gas tax to be suspended through Labor Day -- at the same time his cronies on Beacon Hill still dismiss the repeated calls I and others have made to suspend our state gas tax as a "stunt" and a "gimmick." I'm sorry to tell the Democrats, they can't have it both ways.

---
| Can I count on you to help me put an end to all the misrepresentation and hypocrisy? I am running for Governor to restore honesty and accountability to Beacon Hill.
Are you with me?

## The most important thing you can do this year to protect your rights and our Montana way of life is to support and RE-ELECT Justice Ingrid Gustafson to the Montana Supreme Court.
* Mike Wheat, Montana Supreme Court Justice (retired)

---
---
|
---
You have a very clear choice in the 2022 Montana Supreme Court race, the most important vote you will cast in the general election on November 8, 2022.Justice Ingrid Gustafson is seeking re-election to Montana’s highest court. In her nearly 20 years of judicial experience, the last five on the Montana Supreme Court, she has handled 1000s of cases and earned a reputation for being impartial and fair. She is non-partisan as required by Montana law, and works hard to keep politics out of the courtroom. Justice Gustafson has engaged in bettering our Montana community—starting and operating a drug court; piloting a child welfare court; serving on Yellowstone County’s Park Board, as President of the Amend Park Development Board, and as Big Sky State Games Soccer Commissioner; and decades-long coaching and mentoring youth soccer players and serving as a high school and collegiate soccer referee. She cares deeply about Montana and Montanans. Her opponent, Jim Brown, is a career lobbyist and a partisan politician who advocates for and benefits from out-of-state, large corporate money to promote his candidacy.“I don’t believe there is too much money in politics . . . it should be unlimited,” said Brown, in the documentary, _Dark Money_ , which exposed the influence of out-of-state corporate and illegal campaign activity in Montana. Brown represented the scandal-ridden out-of-state corporate money groups featured in the documentary. He has zero judicial experience and has never even represented a client before the Montana Supreme Court.In the recent primary, over $300,000 of dark money was spent by out-of-state corporations to buy her opponent a place on the general ballot. Although Montana law forbids judicial candidates from seeking partisan endorsements, Brown flouts these laws by participating in partisan events and accepting partisan endorsements.We cannot let this seat on the Montana Supreme Court be bought by out-of-state corporations and extreme partisans. **I ask that you**[**DONATE**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62b34a71305b2062d18db668&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gustafsonformontana.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62b21203940aff2b96f27dac%26ss_email_id%3D62b34a71305b2062d18db668%26ss_campaign_name%3DYour%2Bmost%2Bimportant%2Bvote%2Bthis%2Byear%2B%25E2%2580%25A6%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-06-22T16%253A59%253A37Z&w=6179d71408f9587afc0cb8be&l=en-US&s=VaTqKGZIMY9cRF9VC7-B7B0u4TA%3D)**to Justice Gustafson’s re-election effort today, VOTE for her, and ENCOURAGE OTHERS to do the same.** Learn more about Justice Gustafson and her heritage in Montana [here](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62b34a71305b2062d18db668&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gustafsonformontana.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62b21203940aff2b96f27dac%26ss_email_id%3D62b34a71305b2062d18db668%26ss_campaign_name%3DYour%2Bmost%2Bimportant%2Bvote%2Bthis%2Byear%2B%25E2%2580%25A6%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-06-22T16%253A59%253A37Z&w=6179d71408f9587afc0cb8be&l=en-US&s=1wbBIERi9QqM77miOMejhMSdV8M%3D). Thank you for your consideration and remember to vote and encourage others to vote by absentee ballot or at the ballot box on November 8, 2022. Sincerely,_**Mike Wheat, Montana Supreme Court, Retired.**_ PS: Please donate $700.00, the legal limit, or whatever amount your family can afford by donating on-line at [www.gustafsonformontana.com](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62b34a71305b2062d18db668&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gustafsonformontana.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62b21203940aff2b96f27dac%26ss_email_id%3D62b34a71305b2062d18db668%26ss_campaign_name%3DYour%2Bmost%2Bimportant%2Bvote%2Bthis%2Byear%2B%25E2%2580%25A6%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-06-22T16%253A59%253A37Z&w=6179d71408f9587afc0cb8be&l=en-US&s=9kBvjB_2MFsvwkoPSsrl5DBoSRo%3D) ... body:
Dear Friends,

Our campaign now has more than 100 endorsements from Democratic elected officials, unions, and influential organizations! This is HUGE.

I’m thankful to everyone who is supporting our campaign and I deeply appreciate their votes of confidence that I am the best choice to advocate for our shared Democratic values in Washington. Our rights are under attack by Republicans, and I am committed to defending our democracy and protecting our rights as a Member of Congress.

We reached this milestone today thanks to endorsements from SEIU Florida, Metro Broward Firefighters, and the Florida State Lodge Fraternal Order of Police.

I’m particularly proud of these endorsements because all three unions represent essential workers who were on the frontlines during COVID-19 and who work tirelessly to keep our community safe.
They deserve our deepest gratitude.

These dedicated public servants deserve our respect and support, and I look forward to working with them towards our common mission.

When I was Director of Emergency Management, I worked tirelessly to ensure our frontline workers had the personal protective equipment they needed to stay safe from COVID-19. And once we had vaccines, I ensured they were delivered to those who risked their lives to keep us safe.

I’m going to continue fighting for our frontline workers–and for Democratic values–in Congress. That means tackling our affordability crisis, expanding access to healthcare, protecting reproductive
rights, preventing gun violence, fighting inflation, and more.

I’m incredibly proud of our broad base of support and look forward to partnering with leaders and workers from across our coalition to fight for change.

Thank you for your continued support.

Jared Moskowitz

clean_body: Dear Friends, Our campaign now has more than 100 endorsements from Democratic elected officials, unions, and influential organizations! This is HUGE. I’m thankful to everyone who is supporting our campaign and I deeply appreciate their votes of confidence that I am the best choice to advocate for our shared Democratic values in Washington. Our rights are under attack by Republicans, and I am committed to defending our democracy and protecting our rights as a Member of Congress. We reached this milestone today thanks to endorsements from SEIU Florida, Metro Broward Firefighters, and the Florida State Lodge Fraternal Order of Police. I’m particularly proud of these endorsements because all three unions represent essential workers who were on the frontlines during COVID-19 and who work tirelessly to keep our community safe. They deserve our deepest gratitude. These dedicated public servants deserve our respect and support, and I look forward to working with them towards our common mission. When I was Director of Emergency Management, I worked tirelessly to ensure our frontline workers had the personal protective equipment they needed to stay safe from COVID-19. And once we had vaccines, I ensured they were delivered to those who risked their lives to keep us safe. I’m going to continue fighting for our frontline workers–and for Democratic values–in Congress. That means tackling our affordability crisis, expanding access to healthcare, protecting reproductive rights, preventing gun violence, fighting inflation, and more. I’m incredibly proud of our broad base of support and look forward to partnering with leaders and workers from across our coalition to fight for change. Thank you for your continued support. Dear Peter,
New endorsement alert! I’m so excited to have received the endorsement of the Furlough Cheesecake Sisters, Nikki Howard and Jaqi Wright. Their story is simply incredible. When they were both furloughed as federal employees during a government shutdown, they decided to launch their own cheesecake business to help make ends meet. Now, their company is thriving.
Nikki and Jaqi, small business owners like you represent the backbone of our state’s economy. Your success story is an inspiration to Monique and I, and we are so honored to have received your support. Not to mention, your cheesecakes are some of the best in Maryland!
You can learn more about why Nikki and Jaqi are endorsing our campaign by watching our new video below:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/furloughcheesecakeendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/furloughcheesecakeendorsement?amount=20.22]
If I’m blessed to be Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll be a champion for small business owners like Nikki and Jaqi. I’ll make it easier for small businesses to thrive in Maryland by cutting the red tape and improving access to state contracts, capital, and credit. I’ll also promote economic inclusion for our minority and women-owned businesses (MWBEs) by increasing the state’s MWBE goals by 50%.
Fresh off the heels of this major endorsement alert, will you chip in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to gain 54 new grassroots donations by 11:59 PM tonight, and your support can help get us there.

My bold vision for Maryland includes combating the student debt crisis, protecting and expanding access to abortion care, leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders, lowering the costs of healthcare and housing, and so much more. Dear
Friend,

I hear
from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their
heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled
to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you,
absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the
Rich."

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

Sowell
separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses
real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

As a
friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to
offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of
charge. Click here to get your free copy of "Trickle Down" Theory
and "Tax Cuts for the Rich" now.

Thanks,
Greg

When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek — this is
Jack DeLapp, Stacey Abrams’ Director of Strategy, Targeting and Metrics. I
want to show you a map of Georgia to explain why our goal of raising $1
million before June 30 is so important.

This map shows how TV advertisers divide the state up into media markets.
When campaigns put ads on the air, they have to pay per media market, so
some campaigns only pay to advertise in places they’re sure they can win.

But we’re not like other campaigns. We’re committed to reaching voters in
every corner of the state, in every single media market, not just Atlanta.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1475?refcode=sa_em_220622_B1_Jack_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=704%2E1862389%2Es0W-HX ]But getting ads up on TV — in addition to radio and online ads — all
across the state while running a direct voter contact program is
expensive,
Derek. That’s why I hope you’ll
take a look at this map, and then chip in $5 toward our $1
million goal before our June 30 deadline:

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1475?refcode=sa_em_220622_B1_Jack_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=704%2E1862389%2Es0W-HX ]map of media markets in Georgia

Derek, we know
we will not win every county or every media market in Georgia. But we also
know that, in an election this close, if there is even one more vote we
can earn by sharing Stacey’s message — it’s worth it.

We can only win this election by engaging folks in every corner of the
state — from Columbus to Savannah to Thomasville.

But that takes a lot of resources. And in just eight days, all of our
fundraising numbers will be locked in for our first public report of the
general election. After that, Brian Kemp, national Republicans and the
media are all going to be looking through our finances to see if we have
what it takes to run a competitive campaign.

We need to raise $1 million online between now and June 30 in order to
hire staff, train volunteers, invest in ads on every platform, mobilize
voters and everything else we need to execute the data-driven strategy
that will elect Stacey Abrams.

real difference. I hope you’ll make your

now.

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9f5cb5pf9nqb7h3669ohbpjgpq8j2hln5pji99o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrr4p1l65ojadtgs5r66p1l65im9c30eeqect5kmpjm6oj6c1qbasrkc5jm6p3nmv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666qbbd77mao6cdj4mdi3fc5lclp238h1e8he4933clim9oj0c3i6aoh5u)
| | | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjfd92tnppk9h8jvmfptuo5skdv6jp5rjlgt81k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh60o74clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7p51djpu569g3pp825194k3lc0n5nvumgsinsc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh60o74clh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqhr8nieros8g4gbgih4bf1dutibgafbrdp641h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh60o74clh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Hi ,

Did you know that particle pollution (considered to be one of the greatest threats to life expectancy) soared to the highest levels we’ve seen in decades in 2020?

In fact across the U.S., 29 of the top 30 counties with the highest pollution that year were located in California.

The reason is one that you’ve already guessed: wildfires.

With a looming fire season ahead, The L.A. Times just released an article about the seriousness of California’s wildfires and the detrimental health consequences they incur due to air pollution every year (to the tune of reducing your life expectancy by years).

[You can read that article here. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=b492bf3256&e=f9133ea432)

**But did you know that this is a problem we can actually fix?**

_Californians shouldn’t have to annually brace for devastation every ‘fire season’._

For years I’ve advocated for critical forest management to protect our environment and communities from devastating fires.

We have the technology and resources available to produce thriving, fire-resilient lands that help safeguard Californians from wildfires.

We should be leading the nation; instead, the current administration blames climate change and then lacks the leadership to take the bold, decisive action that Californians deserve.

So please, could you do me a favor and spread this message?

Newsom has done nothing to stop this crisis.

**Come this November, we have a chance to vote for real change** \- a change that could literally save your and your family’s lives.

There is a better future for all Californians on the horizon.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

P.S. [The best way you can help spread this message right now is by joining Dollar-A-Day and funding our campaign. Once elected, my administration will see to it that we solve California’s wildfire and clean air crisis. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=4675219a27&e=f9133ea432)

body:
We can't let this cycle continue | | | Hi Peter, Great to meet you. My name is Colin Flanagan, and I'm running to represent Ohio's 41st District in the Ohio General Assembly. A few things about me:
* **I'm aggressively Ohioan.** I drink pop and pour ranch on everything. I love a good day out on Lake Erie, and I'm pursuing a law degree. I've worked in the Ohio State House, and I'm ready to fight for common sense in Columbus.
* **I'm a proud rural Democrat.** I'm an Ohio guy with a family of union blood. I know what it means to work hard--I've been surrounded by it my whole life. Being a rural Democrat is part of who I am, which means knowing the struggles that working people face – and also knowing that our government isn’t working for them right now.
* **I'm fighting to win in one of the most competitive seats in the country.** My district is one of the two most competitive in Ohio. It's a place where Trump and Biden both won by less than 500 votes in 2016 and 2020, respectively.

As you may have also gathered – I'm a young rural Democrat. **I know what it's like to watch friends and family members get sucked into Republican narratives and then struggle when those representatives fail to get anything done.** My community is desperate for change, and that's why I decided to run for office. But the Republican tide in Northwest Ohio is going strong, and I need all the help I can get to drum up Democratic support. **[That's why I'm proud to be endorsed by United Rural Democrats — a group that is working every day to make sure that rural communities aren't left behind. If you didn’t see the news, the Senate announced bipartisan gun safety legislation.
#
Peter,
If you didn’t see the news, the Senate announced bipartisan gun safety legislation. In short, here’s what’s included in the legislation:
* Major federal funding to build out red flag laws, community violence intervention programs, community mental health grants, school safety grants, and more.
* Significant steps toward closing the “boyfriend loophole” that allowed people convicted with domestic violence to still buy firearms.
* Rigorous background checks for anyone purchasing long guns under 21.
* New federal criminal offenses on gun trafficking and reselling that will help combat guns being shipped from state to state.
* And lastly, an update to our background checks statutes to strengthen the process.

This is significant progress in the right direction. And while Senator Durbin and Senate Democrats know it’s not enough, we must get this legislation passed now.

body:

| I’m about to tell you something that's gonna completely blow your mind — the truth about our state and who we’ve been electing as our leaders. **[But before I do that I need your help to get the truth out. Can you donate $5 or more to my campaign today? Because a lot of folks aren’t going like what I have to say.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46833863/351954195/80455365?amount=25&contactdata=oKg4uB3txTrIuGMlSCzXC0GyT%2FO1F1go%2BwQ%2FVhsTJzD2hevOongO9F87RVpkjC2lNR8EPL0kOEznSNQP6XPU1qWA2sx1dFLSvhTFD1JvSQM%3D&source=JC_EM_FR_3MO_20220622_1_1&utm_source=jc_em_fr_3mo_20220622_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTI2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjZjYmQ3ZC01ZWYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L3q0_u7RfIPo2eJ55ErKmlGt1B98a8DLihac_teBDLI=)**

Now that I asked, here it goes...

Airline pilots are forced to retire at age sixty-five.

Federal law enforcement officers? Fifty-seven.

Judges here in South Carolina? Seventy-two.

**But have you ever noticed politicians hardly _ever retire?_** Our country and state are being run by a Geriatric Oligarchy—people who stay in office way past their prime.
