body:
Now I’ll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zprsuemf6209fbhbf4ps4srkcu56iccndqd7f9s0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onic9orcodgejjj7db461pbac336dh38sdle2qn2sthmhpr6dbkseq70t3kmar7eduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74db66aob6oj7mti6cc5gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z21eo11n8sikrf9evdrnpbvtd0tuio02otupcqdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5kj8vkiorlfi9gbr4p9bh8jci2o3c8f7aph0asg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zh8rj0e57atie73pgjmfs274c8jv5pjoi3t2noo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zef4rlkq6699n6mp23hdhi86gh30hua36vm4ks6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zgu72uv5bf3q4stiihhb0ho2ckfbu9vu4oqqpi4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9ia3dv5tor3ma06lf41tdah33rqp89jv1epu3mo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z3gdl0b2pls99089qgschhpc994rqln8gb3vt1q8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8k9ab0be5oigc483ngek1a7ihvla4je01aog880_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmia48igmabsdfu6ofbk2t19foc5grbk0rj9a5so_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zb6653305uer5npeuppi8stbn608uhqsp3v6813g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z6e945i08gh14s1a4lfvhd08sjl2ue3rts427n38_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zokb0726h5buj47e8uh5p6c815aq1nq8qggmcir8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9d1ss3q1ueungr9ejjqek1k5pp4pjmq2kaungkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsnk3rocb0k1u553h1s7an5sk31ckelrc0qhtkkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmpaivtnbbv65bl1qikcaqf47s7dk86gk3ftsndg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2iv1p8eqkr2gnoebh3v3sgv85plfk7legjnjofo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ztkbsmrsjtrm1c3fjn7d7rv2o8es205qg5vff4d8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0rev5654tqmgfq5l451ni9kgt34eskmloja5iig_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh62o71chh2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

| | | Peter, I raised my son Michael as a single mother.

Being a single mom isn’t easy. I held three jobs and barely slept. But it was worth it to watch my son grow up into the incredible soldier, husband, and father he is today.

He didn’t squander the example of hard work I gave him or take my sacrifice for granted. He dedicated his life to service, attended college at the Virginia Military Institute, and became an elite Special Forces Green Beret.
---
---
Being a military parent is hard. You’re always worried you’ll get the call every parent dreads. But he sent me pictures and letters from Afghanistan every chance he could. That’s the kind of man Michael is - he never forgets where he came from.

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: I'm running for Senate to take the price tag off the American Dream
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
| | |

**Peter, the American Dream isn't just about surviving. It's about prospering. **
You can't do that if you're worrying about how to afford child care, keep the lights on, pay for gas to get to work, put food on the table for your family, and keep going amidst it all.
Far too many Missourians are struggling to make their hard-earned paychecks stretch to cover all the costs of daily life. Something has to change.
**But honestly, it seems like politicians in Washington care more about making their ultra-wealthy donors happy than making life better for families.**
I'm running for Senate to take the price tag off of the American Dream. **That's why today, I released[ _my full plan_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46834200/351955550/2070851513?refcode=jtk41-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTQ3MGQ1MS02MGYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Es2WB3-rsztSmtsNTfaTMH4qADwRpYijpcs05zsSEDE=&emci=cdf222dd-7be3-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=41470d51-60f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063) to give working families and their kids the wages, financial security, and opportunities they deserve. **
| | [Read my plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46834201/351955551/2070851513?refcode=jtk41-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTQ3MGQ1MS02MGYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Es2WB3-rsztSmtsNTfaTMH4qADwRpYijpcs05zsSEDE=&emci=cdf222dd-7be3-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=41470d51-60f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)
---
I know this is no easy task. But there are meaningful, impactful steps that we can take – like these:
* Lowering the cost of basic necessities like gas, groceries, housing, and prescription medication
* Making sure that the wealthiest Americans are paying their fair share
* Supporting families struggling with the high costs of child care and elder care
* Raising the federal minimum wage and passing legislation to protect our unions

**[I'm really excited about this plan. Can you take a moment to read through it right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46834202/351955552/2070851513?refcode=jtk41-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTQ3MGQ1MS02MGYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Es2WB3-rsztSmtsNTfaTMH4qADwRpYijpcs05zsSEDE=&emci=cdf222dd-7be3-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=41470d51-60f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

Trudy Busch Valentine

name: Andrew Badger
subject: What went wrong? ... Webinar on Afghanistan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andrew Badger for Congress
body:
| Dear Peter, It's clear there's no accountability in Washington. Democrats are destroying our country, and establishment Republicans like Mitt Romney & Blake Moore are letting them get away with it. **My wake up call to this fact was our catastrophic collapse in Afghanistan last summer.** It made me realize we need stronger Republicans in office who are prepared to fight back and actually hold the Biden administration accountable - not just on Afghanistan, but also on our broken border, Big Tech meddling in our elections, and the never ending money printing that's driving inflation. **This Thursday (23 June) at 8 PM I will be delivering a presentation on what went wrong in Afghanistan, breaking down the tactical & strategic mistakes that led to America's downfall there after 20 years of war. ** This issue in particular is very important to me. I volunteered to deploy to Afghanistan in 2014 as a civilian officer with the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA). My job was to recruit human informants to provide strategic intelligence support to our military warfighters. Simply put, we have to understand the lessons of the past, so we don't repeat the same mistakes in the future. You can register for the Zoom webinar here: | [](https://www.badger2022.com/r?u=iKj5iuxBXy-0B6ifolAJk1NJIidI-1LbAvybYlyuWUJS_h3awlwaZiRJ0NiRG9e7CbSOzKOXV9Fhs2SG_SpkRal9TkQRnE39GuR_e6LOH7g&e=51766ec46a0196629bb5b9bba5bfa850&utm_source=andrewbadger&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghanistan_webinar_supporters&n=1 "Register") [Register](https://www.badger2022.com/r?u=iKj5iuxBXy-0B6ifolAJk1NJIidI-1LbAvybYlyuWUJS_h3awlwaZiRJ0NiRG9e7CbSOzKOXV9Fhs2SG_SpkRal9TkQRnE39GuR_e6LOH7g&e=51766ec46a0196629bb5b9bba5bfa850&utm_source=andrewbadger&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghanistan_webinar_supporters&n=1)
---
**I will also be answering questions about my campaign and my vision for US foreign policy, including how we should approach the growing geopolitical threat from Communist China.**
Look forward to seeing you soon!
Best regards,

Peter,

Our country is facing a gun violence epidemic. So far this year, more than 9,000 lives have been lost due to gun violence. And in 2020, guns overtook motor vehicle accidents to become the number one cause of death in children.

Enough is enough. It's long past time we took meaningful action to combat the gun violence epidemic facing our country.

**In the House, Kim is working to pass common sense gun safety legislation to keep our communities safe.** Earlier this month, she helped pass the Protecting our Kids Act. This legislation will help prevent gun violence by raising the purchasing age for semi-automatic rifles, strengthening safe storage requirements, outlawing high-capacity magazines, and more.

She also helped pass legislation that allows family members and law enforcement officers to temporarily remove access to firearms for an individual who is deemed a danger to themselves or others, and she introduced bipartisan legislation that would provide tax incentives to gun sellers to also sell a gun lock or safe with all gun sales.

Kim knows that gun safety shouldn't be a partisan issue. She's working hard in Congress to ensure our families are safe from gun violence, but with the Senate now considering the most significant gun safety legislation in decades, she wants to know what you think:

Hi Derek — it’s Eve, Adam’s wife. And yes, we’ve heard all of the jokes. (Adam claims I only went out with him on our first date as a curiosity — which is, _mostly_ , an exaggeration.)
As you can imagine with all that Adam has on his plate right now — running the intelligence committee, holding Trump accountable, preparing for the midterms — he has been understandably very very busy. He’s working day in and day out to fight for our democracy and for his constituents.
Adam’s dedication to our country is admirable, and I’m proud of him, but I know sometimes this job can wear down on him — it would wear down on _anyone_. But today is his **_birthday_** , and I want to make sure he knows how much we all appreciate him.
That’s why I’m planning a little birthday surprise for him. I’m taking him to see _To Kill a Mockingbird_ this weekend (the play), but that’s not the surprise. The surprise is this: I want to give Adam a birthday card signed by his favorite team of grassroots supporters, by all of you.
[**Can you add your name to Adam’s birthday card today? It’ll only take a minute, but it will mean the world to him. | | **Friends,

The tremendous response we've had at our several events around the district since the runoff confirms our campaign's momentum going into the last week of the race. We had almost 100 people at our event last night. Our opponent has done a poll of the race, but has not released it, that tells me a lot about how we're doing!

The biggest difference in the two campaigns is that his is dependent on lies, half-truths, and Swamp and Wall Street money, and ours is built on the America First message and the backbone, energy, and heart of the people of the 3rd District like you. And we're going to need that energy in the last six days before June 28th. If you can help spread the message by e-mailing or texting our literature (the two pictures attached) to your contacts within the district, that will do wonders, just like it did before the June 7th election.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Add your name to say YOU support the bipartisan gun safety legislation being debated in the Senate.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Last night the Senate voted to begin debate on the bipartisan gun safety legislation you’ve been reading about in the news.
#

Friends -
Last night, the Senate voted to begin debate on the bipartisan gun safety legislation you’ve been reading about in the news.
We overcame tough negotiations and an initial procedural vote. Now, the Senate could vote any day and send it to President Biden’s desk very soon.
It takes courage to act, and I’m proud to see Democrats and Republicans come together to introduce this bill.
Since being shot, I’ve learned that when people care for each other and work together, progress is possible. A better world is possible.
There is more important work to be done, but this legislation takes important steps needed to protect communities and save lives from gun violence.
I urge the Senate to pass it without delay, and I want them to know how many Americans agree it’s time for action.
[**Please sign Giffords’ petition. Add your name to say YOU support the bipartisan gun safety legislation being considered in the Senate. It’s a small ask, but says a lot about the grassroots support for the bill.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/senate_vote_petition_em/?source=em220622-1-15&t=1&akid=2161%2E3935704%2EzmcQYD)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/senate_vote_petition_em/?source=em220622-1-15&t=2&akid=2161%2E3935704%2EzmcQYD)**
This will be the first significant gun safety legislation passed in almost three decades, and it’s only possible because of the work we’ve done together for more than a decade now. Thank you for your tireless support along the way.
With courage,
Gabby Giffords

Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Hi Peter,
I’m emailing you with something a little different today. Instead of asking you to support our work, I’m asking you to support a dear friend and future colleague.
From Texas to New York, working families need representatives who will fight and deliver for them in Congress. That’s why I’m proud to endorse New York’s Congressman Jamaal Bowman for re-election today, and I hope you’ll join me in supporting him. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-jamaal-bowman?refcode=06.22_gc_email_list]
CHIP IN NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-jamaal-bowman?refcode=06.22_gc_email_list]
When we get to Congress in January, I’ll already have allies like Congressman Bowman in the fight for gun reform, a living wage, Medicare for All, the right to an abortion, and so much more.
As a former school principal and local organizer, Congressman Bowman is the exact kind of leader I want to be fighting alongside. He inspires and supports new leaders, and now it’s time for us to support him. Can you chip in $16 today to help us get to Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-jamaal-bowman?refcode=06.22_gc_email_list]
Congressman Bowman was the first member of Congress to support me last fall, and I’m incredibly proud to endorse him for re-election now. He is one of the most genuine, kind, and hard-working people I have met so far. I’m committed to helping him get across the finish line in his race [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-jamaal-bowman?refcode=06.22_gc_email_list] so that we can work side by side in Washington.
Let’s keep organizing,
- Greg

The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8pqe6anr7ihauo4ghks1ntoof9g3mpaeue0s8dg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh61o32c1h2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z551o63udfja8k661ql7fhlmakcqclpvi8dqlueo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh61o32c1h2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

public office.

body:
[](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNjzFvwyAUhH-NvcWCZxsng4dKVbZ07Yie4dlBwYDgWe3PL4navdJNdzrdd3a2xqI0rZtBAAgFIBWo_txdBIiR-skOEtQ0LM0g0FPmLlM6Fu8MBsbyWGM21Jm4t_d5EmhHOyKZwVwMTRIvclW0SHsWZhls-3nTN3Tehe0Dd5ozrzoXHRPrxdO341OiXGJAr9UJoEpD6-c7cypN_9bAtaqQOTJ1GMhGfg5X77e9xiNYZBdD9VJMaBifpf568K4N7gndFpr-_e9qA-qVxMAUuAaVqM2zTV_Oe1fUVE9veyV-HeR_Af8ADEdwGg)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNjzFvwyAUhH-NvcWCZxsng4dKVbZ07Yie4dlBwYDgWe3PL4navdJNdzrdd3a2xqI0rZtBAAgFIBWo_txdBIiR-skOEtQ0LM0g0FPmLlM6Fu8MBsbyWGM21Jm4t_d5EmhHOyKZwVwMTRIvclW0SHsWZhls-3nTN3Tehe0Dd5ozrzoXHRPrxdO341OiXGJAr9UJoEpD6-c7cypN_9bAtaqQOTJ1GMhGfg5X77e9xiNYZBdD9VJMaBifpf568K4N7gndFpr-_e9qA-qVxMAUuAaVqM2zTV_Oe1fUVE9veyV-HeR_Af8ADEdwGg)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNjzFvwyAUhH-NvcWCZxsng4dKVbZ07Yie4dlBwYDgWe3PL4navdJNdzrdd3a2xqI0rZtBAAgFIBWo_txdBIiR-skOEtQ0LM0g0FPmLlM6Fu8MBsbyWGM21Jm4t_d5EmhHOyKZwVwMTRIvclW0SHsWZhls-3nTN3Tehe0Dd5ozrzoXHRPrxdO341OiXGJAr9UJoEpD6-c7cypN_9bAtaqQOTJ1GMhGfg5X77e9xiNYZBdD9VJMaBifpf568K4N7gndFpr-_e9qA-qVxMAUuAaVqM2zTV_Oe1fUVE9veyV-HeR_Af8ADEdwGg)

I am breaking the rules.

name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Please see – FW: URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships?
body:
I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeacecum37i2lv6rcgpaasl1t4eta3f5bhq8ta5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh69o72cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65s36cor6athl68onctlimapb6t9j65i66dhks2rb6p1lm5jjattlcgrrap75chjrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p3aphim2pm9ptnc9j30s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkgd7nqq6eejml8i8kfm9ojpg36aifca3lkd3v60_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh69o72cph2bs) Fellow Conservative, I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training program is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. My staffer Bryan, who oversees the Leadership Institute’s campus programs, sent an urgent email to let me know **the demand by students to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpm2v7dkrq2f198avqk4sa981rjd8ghhvfg80610_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh69o72cph2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbg9gugbb53uo0boj53lv89jpvna4jk3cmrmknp8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cjh69o72cph2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
* * *
**From:** Bryan Bernys
**To:** Morton Blackwell
**Subject:** URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships? Morton, I just got confirmation that we can move the National Youth Leadership School to the university auditorium. That takes care of the classroom space issues we had. But now there’s a financial issue. With the increase in travel costs, we’ve used up everything in the scholarship fund for students’ travel and hotel rooms. My team still have **50 more applications** to process from students who want to come to the training. Is there any room left in the budget for more student travel scholarships? I don’t want to have to tell my team to turn students away who can’t afford to come, but there’s no other option if we can’t get more scholarship funding. Please let me know how to proceed as soon as possible. Respectfully, Bryan \--
**Bryan Bernys**
Vice President for the Campus Leadership Program
Leadership Institute

Team, The day after the shooting at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, I got to work with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to come up with a solution to help restore safety and security in our communities. Senators Murphy, Cornyn, Tillis, and I developed a commonsense plan to protect our communities and keep families safe. **Our _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ will protect America’s children, keep our schools and communities safe, and reduce the threat of gun violence across the country.** Our plan will save lives. It invests in school safety, boosts mental health resources, cracks down on illegal gun sales, ensures background checks are effective, and, critically, keeps guns out of the hands of individuals convicted of domestic abuse. As a social worker, I’ve worked with domestic violence survivors for nearly 30 years, and I’ve seen the trauma that domestic violence can have on children and how it negatively affects a young person’s life when growing up. Our bill protects survivors of domestic abuse, ensuring more kids and families can grow up in safe homes, free from the fear of gun violence. subject: Some talk. Others get it done.
body:
As Mayor, Bill de Blasio won universal pre-K and 3-K in New York City.
# [](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/201?t=1&akid=168%2E39519%2EeNSXO1)

Friends -
As Mayor, Bill de Blasio won universal pre-K and 3-K in New York City.
Who better to make the case for it in Congress?
On his watch, New York City ushered in a $15 minimum wage, paid sick leave and guaranteed health care — including mental health services.
Who better to make the case for them in Congress?
While Mayor, income inequality was actually reduced in New York City!
Who better to talk about how to get it done across the country?
Here is the truth:

Our next Texas Ethics Commission (TEC) public filing deadline is quickly coming up on June 30. At the end of the month, we'll close the books and release our fundraising numbers for everyone — reporters, pundits, and Greg Abbott — to see.
**To be transparent, our numbers are not currently where we need them to be.** Right now, we're falling behind our fundraising projections and at risk of being outraised by Abbott for the _fourth_ time in a row.
**But here's the good news:** We know from previous TEC reports that we have way more grassroots support than Abbott.

A few days ago, while I was leaving an event in Rifle, Colorado, someone threw something at me and shouted a homophobic slur.

I have hesitated if I even wanted to bring this up, but I think it’s important I share this with you.

You see, according to multiple studies most LGBTQ people have experienced harrassment soley because of their sexual orientation or gender identity.

This wasn't the first time this has happened while on the campaign trail, and honestly, I don’t think it’ll be the last.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46840155/351983296/-744169294?refcode=Header&ms=Header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTcyMTRhYi03NmYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l-CiEeRQm31asJ3lSd0Nwv0oTQDU1t-lJb6CGGQKgXo=&emci=4cdc2a68-60f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=297214ab-76f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725) Peter,

In a time where your existence is under attack, celebration is an act of resistance.

After years of progress, Republicans in states across the Nation have passed new laws to further restrict the rights of LGBTQ+ people, while others are attempting to erase their existence entirely.

I cannot know what it's like to live under constant threat of that kind of erasure, but I've witnessed friends and loved ones face that threat and still choose to come out. I admire their courage, but I also wish that it wasn't necessary. Everyone should have the right to live authentically and love whom they love.

So once again this month, I want to encourage you to celebrate pride with the LGBTQ+ people in your life and show care and compassion for yourselves.

I also want to ask you to take action. We stand at a critical moment where the rights that LGBTQ+ people have won in the courts could easily be erased. And today, too many still face the threat of being evicted or denied services for being gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, or queer.

**[It's time for federal legislation to end discrimination against LGBTQ+ Americans. If you agree, will you stand with me and demand action this Pride Month?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46840156/351983300/1206534142?ms=em22_220622_pride_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&refcode=em22_220622_pride_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&source=em22_220622_pride_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220622_pride_adv_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=%2FGX8iPUQAQM%2BoRNufqkOet3XGeMaZB2pFI0gKrcidXe8Ck2RBd%2Ft541Fw1NXRkBrVoVByZTWYFY%2FXD8KQpIrr1iAggJ2iJqWe15TfZeyx0%2Bp8%2Bq1fmIg9ocnLBZI%2B9X3UuCIf20Ln55Cbr%2BUIbherB%2BvpsPkRM4dtQcIkJdRclTeTlKbtw8fFkfINcaUt5Rk&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTcyMTRhYi03NmYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l-CiEeRQm31asJ3lSd0Nwv0oTQDU1t-lJb6CGGQKgXo=&emci=4cdc2a68-60f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=297214ab-76f2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725)**

The House has already passed the Equality Act, but the Senate has not. I am proud to be a co-sponsor of this legislation, but I'll need your help to get it passed into law.

By showing your support for the Equality Act, you can help provide the momentum to ensure that LGBTQ+ Americans of all races no longer face the threat of losing their homes or being denied public accommodation because of their gender or whom they love.

Though we live in a challenging time, we cannot allow those who would erase LGBTQ+ people to win.

We must celebrate pride, and we must act. I look forward to debating, sponsoring, and passing more legislation to protect the civil rights of every American, and I'm glad to have you with me in this fight.

Thank you,

Bob Casey

subject: North Carolina basketball and politics have a lot in common

body:
#

North Carolina is home to me. It’s where I grew up, and it sits at the center of the universe for both of my loves — basketball and politics.
As a kid growing up on the north side of Charlotte, I never imagined that I’d win an NCAA championship or play basketball with the 44th President of the United States.
On this crazy journey, the one thing I learned is that it takes a team to come together to get big wins and bring about real change. Whether it is winning the ACC tournament, passing the Affordable Care Act, or working to elect the first African American President of the United States. They require teams of people working together for a larger purpose.
President Obama taught me what it took to be a public servant, and at the core, we need leaders with a deep understanding of communities and empathy for those constituents.
North Carolina has the chance to elect just that kind of leader as our next U.S. Senator with Cheri Beasley. She has dedicated her life to fighting for North Carolinians and for justice throughout the state.
Cheri is someone we can trust to always put North Carolina families first.
But like President Obama taught me, I know she can’t do it alone. It takes a team, and to turn North Carolina blue in November, Cheri needs all of us behind her.
[**Will you please consider making a $3 donation to Cheri’s campaign for U.S. Senate today? It’s going to take a lot of grassroots support to flip this seat, so every donation will make a difference.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220622-1-ma&refcode2=1090.357359.9znYIO&t=1&akid=1090%2E357359%2E9znYIO)

I know firsthand there are things that can divide us — in politics and in basketball.
But I deeply believe Cheri Beasley can bring us together to win.
Together is the key word there. What I learned from my front-row seat on the 2008 Obama campaign was that a group of folks working together around a common cause can make a difference.
It’s how we won my home state then and elected our first Black president, and it’s how we will win this fall to elect our state’s first Black senator.

Friends, We’re rounding the corner on addressing gun violence. I’ve been part of these bipartisan negotiations from the start. Why? Because the more we’re able to engage in the work of addressing gun violence — as opposed to just viewing it as a political stand-off — the more we can accomplish and the more lives we can save. **Now, we’re voting on common-sense legislation that will make our communities safer.** While we still have work to do, these measures will save lives and take on gun violence at home and internationally. We will do this by funding enforcement of crisis intervention orders, protecting survivors of domestic violence, enhancing the review process for gun buyers under 21 years old, clarifying who is required to conduct background checks, investing in mental health services, and more. I’ve also led on provisions to crack down on straw purchasing in the United States and trafficking firearms outside of the United States. With these provisions, we will take on the illegal use of middlemen to purchase guns. And we can cut down on gun violence in places like Mexico, El Salvador, and Honduras — places where guns trafficked from the United States account for most of their gun violence. **Let me be clear: I’m a responsible gun owner who believes in taking on issues of public safety and protecting constitutional rights at the same time.** I’m not new to this work. When we lost 58 innocent people in a devastating mass shooting in Las Vegas in 2017, I brought forward legislation to ban the sale of bump stocks and other devices that enable semi-automatic weapons to work like automatic ones. I was a leading voice in the fight to repeal the Dickey Amendment and finally allow the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to fund research on how gun violence impacts public health. I’ve also led the fight to address public safety and reduce crime here in New Mexico. I recently helped secure $350,000 in federal funding for the Doña Ana County Sheriff’s Office's Rapid DNA program to rapidly identify suspects and victims. Earlier this year, I helped bring in $1 million to support New Mexico women who were previously incarcerated in rebuilding their lives. One of my top priorities is keeping people safe and ensuring our communities have the resources to make that happen. That’s why I will always be a voice for public safety and common-sense gun safety legislation in the U.S. Senate. Thank you for being an important partner in this work. — Martin

clean_body: Our campaign is garnering attention all over the state, but when you’re going up against the political establishment, you’re always the underdog. | = | Peter, I’m emailing to let you know that there are only four short weeks — 28 days! — until our Primary Election, and it’s all hands on deck as we head into the “get out the vote” phase of this election. In the last few weeks, we’ve seen a massive surge in momentum following the poll that put our campaign just one point behind frontrunner Peter Franchot. We’ve racked up endorsements from huge statewide organizations, from Our Revolution to Sierra Club MD to Pro-Choice Maryland Action to, most recently, Sunrise Maryland. But we can’t get complacent — with just four weeks left, we need to build on this momentum and keep going! = Our campaign is garnering attention all over the state, but when you’re going up against the political establishment, you’re always the underdog. That’s why in these next critical weeks, we need your help to keep our ads up on TV and share my story and vision for Maryland with more undecided voters. This campaign is fueled by grassroots donations, so I’m humbly asking for your support today — = | = = = With your support, we can bring lasting change to Maryland: committing to net-zero emissions by 2035, protecting LGBTQ+ folks of all ages, and building world-class schools committed to inclusion and achievement for every student. We really can win this, Peter, but we’re going to need everyone to chip in to make it happen. Please, give what you can today — every dollar makes a difference! Hi Friend

As a homeschooling dad myself, protecting our children from indoctrination, especially in public schools, has been a mission of mine even before I became a candidate for Congress.

I believe that children's minds hold the ideas that point the nation's future direction. This is why the Left is so determined to get into our schools. Their agenda of corrupting young, impressionable minds with Godlessness, sexual perversion, gender fantasies, and racist ideologies that divide rather than unite cannot be allowed to continue.

A few weeks ago, I held a rally in support of 3 school board members who were targeted by the school board because they actually dared to stand up for the children instead of the "agenda." If you're interested, I'll put the link to the video of the event at the bottom of this email.

Because of my determination to fight for parental rights, I am so proud to announce that I have been endorsed by[ Parents' Rights In Education (PRIE)](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wpzrAMGvUovYGOhdAhzB6Lvm97d6gsDrn_skJaJ-AsDGFNHN28CBlELfpf4mFM-G13m79yurdDCuRrz-scB6e_lI3mN1XPUhOVDpf4hUa7aFGjsz0m2lKOyuosGuctFkT5gzY2LeynilisFqcQGADfhJiyVGVJghWQa3LyUU7-zYS05EGySWDar9BDRkAtcFM8BHzvPU1XNcLYCjO31Kq6axfL8yJ05yyNImvrsrXAAarj0tMoF9bfXIbsXyhWUZ&c=wS0SamLrpII32ozeT-9SgEe4Ap1XN3WvpYEBnwVHnTqcBRNOjDdYFg==&ch=MW4c0BrznnQ83I2UoRlIlLobOBWRnzVnXZaCjM7da3EkRrGgoRR4tw==).

---
|
PRIE strives to protect the rights of parents and " for the return of community values properly represented and reflected in school policies, without the current trend of coercion and reprisal as concerns are voiced."
Our children --their ideas, innovations, dreams, and the way they will choose to govern this country in the future are at risk of being destroyed by a woke minority determined to fill their minds with racist lies and sexual filth.
We need a fighter in Congress who will not back down from wokeness and cancel culture. I am that candidate.
[Please consider supporting my campaign for Congress. name: Cecile Richards
subject: I won’t let this deter me
body:
Derek, the U.S. Supreme Court intends to overturn Roe v. Wade, taking away abortion rights from millions of Americans.
I’m furious, but I won’t let this deter me. I’m committed to turning my outrage into action. I’m calling on you to do the same.
Right now, Sen. Maggie Hassan is running for reelection to represent New Hampshire. She’s got a tough fight ahead, with the GOP spending millions on attack ads against her. But Maggie is a proven leader – she’s a fierce advocate for women’s rights and reproductive freedom.
And if elected again, Maggie Hassan will continue to fight to defend the right to safe and legal abortions. But to do that, she urgently needs your help.
So, Derek, with so much hanging in the balance, will you split a donation of $25 right now between Maggie Hassan’s campaign and CommonGood we can make sure we elect more pro-choice leaders who will fight to protect our rights – not take them away? ---
Fellow American,

The media knew the truth, but they still printed the story.

Democrats and the media are trying to create a fake controversy with my campaign because the economy is a mess and it's the Democrats' fault. Since they can't win on the issues, they are coming after my family and my children. _**That's a step too far.**_

Fellow American, I knew this race could get ugly, but I never thought they'd bring my family into it.

Many people avoid politics because of the nasty things that are said and done. I knew what I signed up for when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, but I thought it was worth the risk if I could help get America back on track.

**The fact that they are bringing my children into the race is absolutely unacceptable. Come after me all you want, but leave my family out of it.**

**But let me be clear: even this despicable level of gutter politics is not going to break my resolve. As the Prophet Isaiah said, no weapon formed against me shall prosper!**

When things get tough in life, sometimes it seems like giving up is the easiest way out. _**But I've never been a quitter. In fact, I dig deeper and work even harder when I'm challenged.**_

_Thanks for standing with me._

clean_body: I love my family more than anything. So when the media and my opponents went after them – that was too far. | Fellow American, The media knew the truth, but they still printed the story. Democrats and the media are trying to create a fake controversy with my campaign because the economy is a mess and it's the Democrats' fault. Since they can't win on the issues, they are coming after my family and my children. That's a step too far. Fellow American, I knew this race could get ugly, but I never thought they'd bring my family into it. Many people avoid politics because of the nasty things that are said and done. I knew what I signed up for when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, but I thought it was worth the risk if I could help get America back on track. The fact that they are bringing my children into the race is absolutely unacceptable. Come after me all you want, but leave my family out of it. But let me be clear: even this despicable level of gutter politics is not going to break my resolve. As the Prophet Isaiah said, no weapon formed against me shall prosper! When things get tough in life, sometimes it seems like giving up is the easiest way out. But I've never been a quitter. In fact, I dig deeper and work even harder when I'm challenged. Fellow American, I need to know if you're with me today. Your digital signature will let me know you've got my back, and it will send a signal to the media that we're sick of their activism reporting. Thanks for standing with me. Sent from my iPhone —--forwarded message below—-- **AG Derek Schmidt proposes ‘Retire Tax Free’ to eliminate retirement income tax in Kansas

** **TOPEKA – (June 22, 2022)** – Kansas Attorney General and Republican Candidate for Governor Derek Schmidt today announced his “Retire Tax Free” plan to eliminate state income tax on Kansans' retirement benefits and savings.
"The Schmidt-Sawyer administration is going to focus every single day on growing Kansas, and if we’re going to do that we can't keep losing retirees at such a high rate to other, more tax-friendly states,” Schmidt said. "To every retiree considering leaving Kansas after a lifetime of working and living here, we want you to stay. To every retiree in another state looking to move, come to Kansas. We’re going to give you another reason to remain or return to Kansas by helping you Retire Tax Free."

Kansas is currently among the states with the highest outbound migration in America. According to surveys compiled by moving companies and data from the U.S. Census Bureau, Kansas ranked poorly at [10th worst in 2020](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd4FUiIgsnv-DokUxRj0ysRS579PTfLwgXHhuPAGq00xL6GImN-XapxW759Qz0CnaBQlyE189C6bx60NFma8alFPjjOkIXohRBJJ8iZ88bvafnqNXRla8ZT9DJEbx5FDp1fWInAUdY6XYt7xJfd2WkORdWq_SrhGVChGdsh1snhqB7VmSRmjqZSahpWNqB9BdqKWcjjh30QdCMo76KxWhFIqqgR9a_G8SLUwgHC08EtwNUgJeGcY_WT2o-WV2Wv8Fm9L1sXnbiSu6IP7-i3jV5L4%3D) and [11th worst in 2021](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFdxUj1gF0jJa3_faBiMnR7oO1lUdtUE14jeM-AUDocAxAY1IUidZpTxsj0VdFAmJRChyZ7kwJHjm8Ilz7jpiLE5IoV1Q1i1lK2pNNnLsgbUqeKjQsAVVQ6JefZ5fTA9fxQUD9-joTvWI8nYvM5XlA_Wb59IY98CHLqD4ogHbnQYwhWf0EXXvQWLcrLnH1LNGR0W1kiU0FTaJJpX_EJzLbXiQEeDfeLYvJ9t7Hpf90rYb_W2SUHHNh_zOrnmaD8kbFz8oGxARSHIXrCiKAf0cjjO6YUf7pjiIUfJRfDoqPPZFwZR7vhAEzPEgBcYf5vU8s_H3e0ZHkPS1bSXeSATweH8M%3D) for outbound migration. In 2021, Kansas [lost about 5,200 people](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFdztx-7MZAuoc3NQVoUIwjZFkSb8vIFnnsf4Fs8ACsgFLRBooFCH46UMyjt_0za-hYBDwVde7BxuWEVqfYOho4qSqESalsU2TyeeWaFbMZyiqhCEcYSWjqkZGFtqAkh_qK-e6o1O-itnc4_J4ElsAwDQw3aHVG0W4ylHC6K1Ag4yr8kqHj8BLpNv2QcGFddgm4N2m2Dpme3C_FiG5P85ZbWGNigPObWqYGQd8AFMus6SGYY8D10TextY3frQ8YzufsDzVOkjQE2dQZ1iDEq8DrV2IjZff5BF8EHrmZrj1dIB_xI8BbDvaHcjU1H7cSiZPIPMZ5dLWTlL2-m7E46-yLIM8CTB1TTYnsxQ0FcpKTHWmqgvpqUuEybWkz9QLs0UEHF67ZHNTTbwQwG2Ih4au4Oj0v4FSU0K0rUmii6pMDin9) from net domestic outbound migration. Departing retirees are a major cause of that outmigration. Nationwide, retirement is the [third most-common](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd8fBAvvj6ao_o4xWxWfAM_V-NcSAwj2cyg1t2TSXb2nrm7pm4-8Gj1zquYDNnme-z7J9DQwp55CClV7PeZXqu8zwcYaTAFnY5p9mlzndheazirVYR8pD68hJE3TOLAeUrmDsaXgxUYtA7MLMSyj7t3e6Ixnl8mrm_YkR4P_mn4X4zk5ifqLU2-n4VzzEERPIFwQktGWoUVLvxd6J3Tw37vGaRoHbZyMVULfeOAN3sKny_pGqMfyb3eUZ3stPcydIxOjcPqwLY5gRAZpBeod4krgoMS5C3k_3Vg91REessZWMtAOa8YgGzVHmXKSpDrXrtrq_HwXZls4_dkMd5u0MI-E%3D) reason for moving away from a state, and that trend is accelerating. Kansans are increasingly likely to leave at retirement – taking a lifetime of accumulated talent and wealth with them. According to an [annual report](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd8fBAvvj6ao_o4xWxWfAM_UtWQuba-IXlbQYHq2cxoM-5vkf0ZJuwGPb9z1J7cBaXM-VU8lUlEBuEgjG8OOSLQh_GuNMrhpiz3kn8NOsmrAc8HisFSdL9co9iA8rJ7DAt4zSqfYFA7LE214DgBFUce9mcGauSAE8y6R7iRo7zRXSrA3ZRRYiDyXCbvRNuwNwcP-cpFS5sJA0v9UWo1rZZ3pATUvwVTkDa8HLsIgKIYMFlsUz5xa9RUiAKhMSS-zYetLpHqKwYm1z1NMaPJ8Y40zkFTvq_qBVRd7weZc0KVij) on migration data, one in five Kansas respondents says the primary reason they decided to leave the state is retirement, and the state's high tax burden on retirees is widely acknowledged as a significant factor in retirees taking up residence elsewhere. According to another [independent analysis](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd-VJJJMlucV7cCgb6P0ElRv5jrZF-lqCw8J74lzIwS19QCVFxmpqmlWgn4T38s-pHTz7wRQ0osuY7DKI8P8oN_DeopW5cQ7S1QzQpBYZirHC3YUyERUerRsQNlncDWqxBHHVvg63NRmlAQoWgFAH6WsGViu0-TiI2kbSjSuT3lwRODgpuNeY-xjbtW1ppeLXK6A0tbunXoUggK9TyhHNjR7TwYrlSfieRA2XPwJuKP55Ek5OKJq2LojCBAtFfgZvM_x_hD5csVIuehuMhtIZzgoTyJ4LNnq6nW_nJEx8rj0xEQqANWoMVtmurP7NKIjpmA%3D%3D), Kansas ranks as the third-worst state in the country for tax burden on retirees and is in the [least tax-friendly](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd-VJJJMlucV7cCgb6P0ElRssnHB_bnSJrm7_wDQv0nKHdH08b4vYYHPItdlupm0zyGpEFpY3niLNr9h1HCh4aMkf1DkVvjC41Z5sGX5YXN1jcAyI1LI2LLdaRmB-6Cm6iYsZuOU1dMdtJoWxkyK_HSVtkCHFr_ldpnAGpWmJdWpDpbjH8ZoRA_3Yi3YKpbq4Yx3hRjcUC57EsSLcwNpde8aTY4nrv2nMack06zUv3STx7Zd5bP0Hl6PY_QESZ0UChE1l1SjJQ6vO7FJGqNrRUVGmon-O3aSd_ObTzforsENbMl3umKiZs6qwgH9bVsBRtLVmLtV3eErNIUC106iFMPc%3D) category for retirees because of the combined burden of high income, sales, and property taxes. Kansas is one of [only 13 states ](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd92EXq3vf6Ia8wl_mEGDQLujP2F1dWd9g7spxYP4divTYfx0YuiJLNESChUOSJxu6cmopVUaR1yZudmN7qXcWCzogn3rJqBHAbevTXMDbQVXQxbdXRWnGcEcnyFsnY80nq2oXM3cXIKf-YeNNNo6qwbssePuqXvSa23CQcBJt-8hjqDZobwHaY9os5Pm6yRh1N-GNXW0_odF62vZ9hqDHMgjU95WBZ3bHVNj0SWJOTR_JRrlwz0Bn23yJC_jFTbm2dbhwhVni-O5emY3EJqSxHGZmaEMfE989GeXEEDMMKENsgHDjQt42yBzXZViVjnXFutrXTtGk4g2ewnoscJquTU%3D)that do not fully exempt Social Security retirement benefits from state income tax.

The Laura Kelly administration has recommended making matters worse by [_increasing_ income taxes](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFdxUj1gF0jJa3_faBiMnR7oP97SFvOJJa7tA7Bpf-geQW77_w96SSNE7gVUiaCSU427Aoc72QEd-eMD56zNie2fOKNQoBOYWVXCr-Cq0Opcw8PEqcsc20pKSjgm5g2AbOYY9GuK-UsmbCsYM4SKl2EdO_mKqxSX6SnPv1GAPkSZkdT_mYZT04WUwGEfgj6UBPqMRdBdNHyQfWlAL55cg8NBysVmMLR061KIF2sbKvKmac-QRTek7Y6XJbbxvO3ozUQ_HVHYRDVo9equ8E1dQpY6V5Tx6X3MjA-eNR8jQX88B1wyq8Tmbw6xaptYsRg_Dotw%3D%3D) on retirees and other Kansans who earn more than $50,000 per year.
Schmidt’s plan would instead provide relief to retirees living on fixed incomes and struggling with both the rising everyday costs of inflation and shrinking retirement investments because of [market losses](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd2s8mzN3MMhiRupIEsiAOyXq6DFo9cxbBgZHCpg7QWVgA9yVKWQsIOhaTWJ2ssvw0usxEXS59qSU5L1gzamtYnp4NFHPBt1nxgQME-941LrwMd2OQRg0WcSjE2uPTya2GlEZZdqhQ7CRSy5hBWLhHpi99uZ7OG-dKWwRpUoTkS9DY87_hBjI5g_astXXOeO5J9tNlNeSYKH2mp4l5mfaZws_FfpT9v7Qqz3mduNOKZ-gLfOU2wawwfwFTRnb6qqDEZKdFzDqt6skMs8i1IUg6nfjdZs8Zm6vg2TBxGMV4ixc-yeuIDLDfCkz_bLExAT2NA%3D%3D). It also would encourage more retirees of all income levels to remain in Kansas, or move to Kansas, rather than move to other states.

Retire Tax Free is an important first step toward the urgent need to grow Kansas. Kansas finished the prior decade with its slowest population growth since the 1930s, and in nearly four years as governor, Kelly has made matters worse. In 2021, Kansas was one of only 17 states in the country that started the new decade with [net population loss](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFdztx-7MZAuoc3NQVoUIwjZFkSb8vIFnnsf4Fs8ACsgFLRBooFCH46UMyjt_0za-hYBDwVde7BxuWEVqfYOho4qSqESalsU2TyeeWaFbMZyiqhCEcYSWjqkZGFtqAkh_qK-e6o1O-itnc4_J4ElsAwDQw3aHVG0W4ylHC6K1Ag4yr8kqHj8BLpNv2QcGFddgm4N2m2Dpme3C_FiG5P85ZbWF5peCliSt537FXakFyXomO15H_GeedDnUetT75we7tG99-23iUXpFP3A1kQyImckisTbfwkSewPT1BNkmFH0vTAjIabn5IV3ySkR9w2lhvPmIykQeKbfBR-Ik7QcJPKKD_raSjmeiBVQjnpKuXqdIkQ52Y0mLHGiaA78ZsbHzV_LM1n34Va1WwB151aoadXKa5x5UpXdkzZV6PwiY2eBZv). Kelly’s economy ranks among the worst in America according to a [recent report](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=4725c1d136b44442a96b38ac4f2fd34a&_e=mWoIFTCJJmPWRfub4KYFd_Jh52YjCBsNIH-KPS_GSHZYmKPTbY22MAfpFoEVeLbhjFvBrzzoESBjV10gROIWNwek_TASd-LAc6vc5FSg-tZFxE2qwixJcbORUgcmctaYNnRxvhTHygbIn4VojWmooRd5d65jJQSW6PS426HYogNvXztUrtLtSH5G7HWMNXM4mds93ydO-Aj_nAqY2DMGbMSuLamf77YdxnFQGg72Ng4kJNI4ON3P7Y8jt_DaqYHZ1Rx1Hcm9F_afGzUmOdXPQmD0msI0icYRvZaU4m3IHWcSFvojE7RIUs9SsjQEeCebEQf8CidVuwUS6nbKHLkf9g6NzHlXrgPKlqG8M9nluwMgVq8zRJGZihGl2Sb3mCco). Amid those broader economic problems, the state's poor rankings for taxing retirees persist.

"To have a brighter future, Kansas must grow. The ability to Retire Tax Free in Kansas will grow Kansas and add to the civic capital of our communities," Schmidt said. “Our state's heavy tax burden is one of the significant obstacles to population growth and a significant reason so many Kansas retirees move away, taking with them their lifetime of talent, civic involvement, and savings."

* * *

BACKGROUND: Kansas currently taxes all private retirement benefits and retirement-savings distributions subject to federal income tax. Kansas also taxes Social Security benefits of taxpayers earning $75,000 or more. Military pensions, as well as federal and in-state government pensions, are exempt from state income taxes.

PROPOSAL: “Retire Tax Free” would zero out all state income tax on:
* Social Security retirement benefits;

* out-of-state public pensions;

* private pension benefits;

* defined benefit retirement plans;

* defined contribution retirement plans like 401(k)s;

* retirement annuities;

* individual retirement accounts;

* retirement plans maintained or contributed to by an employer, or maintained or contributed to by a self-employed person as an employer; and

* deferred compensation retirement plans or any earnings attributable to the deferred compensation plans.

Schmidt’s plan would make Kansas more competitive in attracting workers by not taxing their pension benefits during retirement and also in retaining current and future retirees. Nationwide, 12 states do not tax retirement income and Iowa is set to join them. In our region, Kansas would join South Dakota, Texas, and most recently Iowa in exempting all private retirement income from taxation. Kansas would join six other regional states in exempting all Social Security income from taxation If effective tax year 2023, exempting all Social Security income is estimated to provide approximately $32.5 million in relief in FY23, $109.2 million in FY24, and $112.5 million in FY25. Fully exempting all private retirement income would provide an estimated $69.9 million in relief in FY23, $233.8 million in FY24, and $236.1 million in FY25.
To keep the state budget and state services stable while implementing tax relief to keep more retirees in Kansas, and to avoid shifting the tax burden to other taxpayers, Schmidt would work closely with the Legislature to determine a fiscally responsible approach to achieving the “Retire Tax Free” goal of full elimination of Kansas retirement income – similar to Schmidt's successful call this year for the Legislature to reduce or eliminate the state sales tax on groceries that resulted in a bipartisan agreement to phase-out the grocery tax. At Schmidt's urging, the Legislature this year also prepaid $1.125 billion in public pension debt, saving about $100 million per year that will be available to offset much of the budgetary cost of this proposed retirement-tax relief for years to come.

# Scott Kaspar endorsed by the National Association for Gun Rights
[I'm honored to be endorsed by the National Association for Gun Rights](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=e9e4efe81b&e=9931950ab1). In a time when Democrats and a few elected Republicans believe the way to deal with criminal gun behavior is to take rights away from law-abiding citizens, we need elected Republicans who will stand firmly for this basic human right to self-defense.

Crime and personal safety remain big concerns I hear from voters every day. My campaign tackled this head on when we launched five months ago by announcing the formation of our [Public Safety Task Force](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=7b035b4cf7&e=9931950ab1) chaired by former NYC Police Commissioner Bernard B. Kerik to find real solutions to the public safety crisis impacting every corner of our district.

National Association for Gun Rights knows that if you give politicians an inch, they'll take a mile. The 2nd Amendment is a fundamental human right which the government cannot take away. This is our guarantee in the Constitution.

Protecting our Second Amendment rights is necessarily part of the solution to the public safety crisis. I am honored to receive the full endorsement of the National Association for Gun Rights for my unequivocal defense of our constitutional rights.

I look forward to working with this excellent organization when I am elected to Congress.

To learn more about my campaign, please visit [www.kasparforcongress.com](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=2e25b7be2a&e=9931950ab1).

clean_body: Scott Kaspar was endorsed by National Association for Gun Rights the premiere 2nd Amendment organization in the United States. | | | | | | | | | Scott Kaspar endorsed by the National Association for Gun Rights . In a time when Democrats and a few elected Republicans believe the way to deal with criminal gun behavior is to take rights away from law-abiding citizens, we need elected Republicans who will stand firmly for this basic human right to self-defense. Crime and personal safety remain big concerns I hear from voters every day. My campaign tackled this head on when we launched five months ago by announcing the formation of our chaired by former NYC Police Commissioner Bernard B. Kerik to find real solutions to the public safety crisis impacting every corner of our district. National Association for Gun Rights knows that if you give politicians an inch, they'll take a mile. The 2nd Amendment is a fundamental human right which the government cannot take away. This is our guarantee in the Constitution. Protecting our Second Amendment rights is necessarily part of the solution to the public safety crisis. I am honored to receive the full endorsement of the National Association for Gun Rights for my unequivocal defense of our constitutional rights. ---
Friend -- This month is Dairy Month, and where better to celebrate it than in America’s Dairyland? Wisconsin agriculture is crucial to our economy and the lives of Wisconsinites. Why, then, do Tony Evers and the left repeatedly hurt farmers in Wisconsin? [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVOrnTv_4TQQTXHR6LLfLnvN6rv1Xo6T-KnPiwSCcyq8U&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dairy_month&n=2) Friend, let’s not forget. Democrats:
* Support the Green New Deal, a death sentence for Wisconsin agriculture
* Tried to raise taxes on farmers
* Proposed a carbon tax that would hurt Wisconsin farmers
* Push policies that advance inflation, which disproportionately affects rural areas

At the end of the day, Wisconsin Democrats would rather appeal to coastal liberal elites than be of any help to hardworking Wisconsinites. Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes continue to put their focus on their woke agenda instead of the issues facing rural Wisconsin. It’s time to vote them out of office. The Republican Party of Wisconsin extends our most sincere gratitude to the hardworking farmers that serve our communities. Your resilience and grit do NOT go unnoticed by Republicans. We will work tirelessly to elect leaders who will fight for Wisconsin farmers, not kowtow to the liberal elites. If you’d like to help the leaders who will help you, sign up to volunteer **[here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dairy_month&n=3)**. Thank you, Wisconsin farmers. \- Team WisGOP

While Texas Democrats like State Sen. Carol Alvarado continue to do everything in their power to fight for the safety of the Lone Star state, Gov. Greg Abbott continues to stand in the way as an immovable object of stubborn selfishness.

4. Including 72 hour cooling period between purchase and possession of a gun.

subject: Our democracy is fragile, and Derek needs your help to protect it.

body:
No one is above the law -- including the president.
Our democracy is at a crossroads, Peter.

On January 6th, far-right extremists staged an insurrection at the U.S. Capitol. Now, in 2022, we are still dealing with the fallout from that day. While the insurrection may have failed, the attacks on our democracy continue.

As the January 6th hearings move forward, we are learning more about the horror that went on behind the scenes. **And many sitting Republican members of Congress -- the very same folks elected to protect our democracy -- chose extremism, party, and power over the American people who trusted them to protect our democracy.**

**Here 's the bottom line: No one is above the law -- including the president.** But as we've recently learned, that didn't seem to stop former President Trump from going against the advice of White House officials and even his own campaign manager. Instead, Trump decided to call a false victory, inaccurately declaring the election a "fraud to the American public."

Peter, Derek is more committed than ever to protecting the cornerstones of our democracy. Hatred and corruption will always yield to justice.

**[If, like Derek and the majority of Americans, you refuse to watch our country, values, and freedoms crumble in the face of extremism, add your name to the petition to urge Congress to pass pro-democracy reform>> ](https://act.myngp.com/el/pHS2yWqOVDNctdvw4z2RpUdaXTRe20lteS1ltG_ymyU=/rO91BSqyJvj6Qu1movIBcDbYO8Xn5Jg9-_9Y73PbyCc=?ms=em22_220622_democr_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&refcode=em22_220622_democr_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&source=em22_220622_democr_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220622_democr_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

We must work to restore checks and balances and strengthen accountability and transparency in our country. History has its eyes on this moment. But Derek is hopeful that historians will write that leaders worked to bring our country together -- to do, as Lincoln stated in his second inaugural address, **" the work we are in to bind up the nation's wounds."**

Derek and House Democrats are continuing to forward legislation that will strengthen our democratic systems to prevent future corruption. We won't stop fighting until these reforms are law.

| Hearing Jill’s story and how she's struggled with the extremely expensive cost of a lifesaving drug reminded me of my family’s experience when my daughter was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I know that Jill’s and my daughter’s stories are only a couple of the many stories of working families struggling to afford prescription drugs like insulin.

That’s why I’m standing up to the drug companies and passed a bill to cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month.

No family should have to make a decision between keeping a roof over their head and paying for medicine. But that’s far too common in the U.S.

**[My first ad of the year focused on the most important issue we face: Everyday families not being able to make ends meet because of corporate greed and how I’m not sitting on the sidelines. Our nation has a sudden epidemic of violence, and "Criminal Justice Reform" District Attorneys like Gascon are fueling it by empowering criminals. Angelenos are fed up with being afraid for their lives every day, and we are days away from recalling Gascon. In March of 2020, repeat criminal Flores was charged with being a felon in possession of a firearm, and by Gascon's rules, his prior offenses weren't considered at his sentencing. So, a felon in possession of a gun simply got probation. Then when two El Monte Police Officers answered a domestic violence call, they were murdered by a man who got a weak sentence because the District Attorney in Los Angeles acts more like a Public Defender than the County's top law enforcement official. Another of Gascon's Special Directives is making LA County taxpayers pay for the funeral of Flores, the repeat felon who killed two police officers. Friend, you may not live in LA County, but we are sounding the alarm nationwide. If we can get a pro-criminal, anti-jail, anti-public safety DA removed from office in Los Angeles, we can stop the nationwide woke “Criminal Justice Reform” movement in its tracks. We need everyone’s help to make this happen. We are collecting signatures to get the recall of George Gascon on the ballot. While we are so close to our goal, we only have a few weeks left to collect the remaining signatures. Can you help us stop the woke criminal justice reform movement by making a quick contribution to our efforts today? Letting woke DA's stay in office is the equivalent of letting violent gangs, murderers, child abusers, and rapists run the County. Your small investment in our mission will go a long way to helping us restore public safety and law and order back to all of our communities. Thank you, Friend, Recall DA George Gascon Committee | | Why Recall George Gascon? As soon as he was sworn into office, District Attorney George Gascon began issuing directives to his prosecutors, instructing them to go soft on crime, coddle criminals, and trample upon the dignity and rights of crime victims. To keep our communities safe, to mete out just punishment to those who break our laws, and to provide justice to crime victims throughout Los Angles County, we must recall District Attorney George Gascon. | Paid for by Committee to Support the Recall of District Attorney George Gascon ID#1440808 500 West Colorado Street, C-455 Glendale, CA 91204 Committee major funding from: Geoff Palmer, Gerald J. ## **TRUE THE VOTE AND PROTECT AMERICA NOW LAUNCH PROTECTAMERICA.VOTE
New partnership will equip sheriffs, inform citizens, and protect our elections**
---
|
## [](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=4d4c44a4c0&e=ad8cba7e98)
---
| [True the Vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=a84d9449cf&e=ad8cba7e98) and [Protect America Now](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=cd648890eb&e=ad8cba7e98) have joined forces in a new partnership to help protect American elections.

[ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=73d01fefa7&e=ad8cba7e98) is an initiative that will provide local sheriffs with information, resources, and tools to support election integrity in their county.

Today, [ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=4a47ed912f&e=ad8cba7e98) released the following Action Plan:

**1\. CONNECT CITIZENS AND SHERIFFS**
Voters are understandably confused by constantly changing election rules and increasingly frustrated by lack of leadership. Put simply, they don’t know where to turn should the election processes break down. Our goal is to unite citizens and their sheriffs to work together, ensuring the real voice of America’s vote is heard loud and clear.

**2. EMPOWER SHERIFFS**
Starting immediately, [ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=5c123c1f11&e=ad8cba7e98) will provide local sheriffs with the information, resources, and tools to have real-time eyes on voting in their counties:
* Providing information on election laws specific to their state
* Developing a grants function to provide technology and support for visibility into allegations of violations as reported throughout their county
* Promoting programs to support citizens and uphold election integrity

**3. OPEN LINES OF COMMUNICATION**
Operate a National Election Integrity Voter Hotline to help citizens in getting information and reporting problems. The hotline will be connected to sheriffs’ offices for quick evaluation of incoming information.

**4. PROMOTE PUBLIC SERVICE MESSAGES**
Beginning August 1st, [ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=b066a79d30&e=ad8cba7e98) will begin an informational campaign to educate voters state-by-state through multiple mediums, including television on election processes and laws.

Catherine Engelbrecht, founder of [True the Vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=d33d5d8e25&e=ad8cba7e98), said _“Over 80% of Americans are concerned about the lack of integrity in America’s elections. Voters want to be helpful but aren’t sure where to turn in times of trouble.[ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=1432e76620&e=ad8cba7e98) will connect citizens and sheriffs, opening communications to support local law enforcement to engage if the need arises.”_

Sheriff Mark Lamb, founder of [Protect America Now](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=1627366287&e=ad8cba7e98), said _“A sheriff's primary duty is to the protect the rights of their constituents, which includes their rights as voters.[ ProtectAmerica.vote](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=c5367703d9&e=ad8cba7e98) aims to solve this problem and bridge the gap between voters and local law enforcement. Our work will ensure we have secure elections in this country.”_

This is the first time we’ll have to report our numbers since the general election began
#

We’re facing a bit of a tough situation ahead of this month’s FEC deadline, and we were hoping you could lend a hand. We’ll explain more in a minute, but if you could [**use this link to make a donation — of $5 or whatever you can afford to give**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22.3xful1&refcode=em220622-1-90&t=1&akid=867%2E159979%2EdA2HMO) — it would mean a lot to Alex and to all of us.
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22.3xful1&refcode=em220622-1-90&t=2&akid=867%2E159979%2EdA2HMO)**
Ok, here’s the deal:
After every quarter, the Federal Election Commission requires candidates for federal office — like U.S. Senator for California — to publicly report how much money they’ve raised.
The Q2 deadline is June 30th at midnight, and this one is extra important because it’s the very first time we’ll report our fundraising numbers during the general election.
And if we come up short — either by not raising enough money or not demonstrating enough grassroots support — our opponents will see that lack of enthusiasm as an opportunity and ramp up their attacks on Alex.
**This is a big deal, so we are asking you directly:**
[**Can you please make a contribution to Alex Padilla’s campaign for U.S. Senate ahead of our FEC fundraising deadline? Every donation, no matter the amount, makes a BIG difference because it’s not just a donation, it’s a powerful statement of support for Alex and our progressive agenda.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22.3xful1&refcode=em220622-1-90&t=3&akid=867%2E159979%2EdA2HMO)

This is the first time we’ll have to report our numbers since the general election began. So if you can afford it, a donation today would really mean a lot to Alex and to the whole team.
Thank you!
Team Alex Padilla
