Mike DeWine is refusing to do anything to save lives.

**“DeWine’s words on lowering gun deaths now ring hollow”**
_**-The Columbus Dispatch, March 20, 2022**_
Team,
This was the headline to _The Columbus Dispatch’s_ editorial in March on Mike DeWine’s decision to put his signature on permitless carry in Ohio, “[sending] a message that the lives lost in Dayton's Oregon District, along with others taken by gun violence, didn’t matter.”
It’s June now, but this headline has unfortunately proven itself to be evergreen: Just last week, in the wake of yet more mass shootings, DeWine signed a bill putting guns into our schools.
**[Ohio deserves better – we deserve a governor who will take real action to make sure we feel safe in our communities instead of one who caves to the gun lobby. Please, chip in $5 right now to help me take on Mike DeWine.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46844038/352004356/403116207?refcode=nw_em_220622_1_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTQyNDY4YS04OWYyLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SZrYCbxhd9yUC_iXMgdWRbkN90et17qJVUw49dymrVc=)**

More guns on our streets and guns around our kids isn’t the way to end the cycle of violence that leaves our communities and our children less safe. But that’s what the gun lobby wants – so that’s the path DeWine has chosen.
As mayor, I called on DeWine to instead push for common sense gun safety measures like universal background checks – measures supported by Ohioans. And as governor, I’ll push to make them a reality.
**[We have to send DeWine and the gun lobby packing, and elect a governor who will make our communities safer. subject: There’s a lot on the line
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
It’s an All Hands On Deck moment, and I need you with me

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=570%2E61531%2E6G8dlo)
Hello,
I’ve spent the better part of my life serving Vermonters—from getting my start working on Bridge Street in White River Junction to representing our Vermont values in Congress. It’s an honor, and it’s what’s driving me to run for Senate—because there’s more work we can do, together, to better the lives of Vermonters.
Right now, with the Senate hanging in the balance, it’s clear we can’t afford to lose a single seat. And if we’re going to keep fighting for an economy that works for everyone, a healthy planet our children can inhabit, and a stronger democracy where we can all participate, we need to maintain Democratic control of the Senate.
[**We’re fast approaching our FEC end-of-quarter deadline. With our numbers going public in just a few short days, can you pitch in $5 right away to help make sure we have what it takes to win?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3029?t=3&akid=570%2E61531%2E6G8dlo)
[CHIP IN ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3029?t=7&t=21&akid=570%2E61531%2E6G8dlo)
---
Republicans, like Mitch McConnell and his allies, have their eyes set on Vermont. They’ve called this a “sleeper” race. That means they hope Vermonters will sit this one out—so they can spend whatever it takes to win here and go unnoticed. Because if they win here in Vermont, they have control of the Senate. And we know exactly what they’ll do: they’ll fight for failure.
But I know this team, and I know Vermont. We’ll come together to show them Vermont is not for sale—and that we’re fighting for our neighbors to lower prescription drug prices, take climate action, and so much more.
**With our numbers going public at the end of the month, we need folks like you to help show how strong this team is.[ Pitch in a $5 contribution or anything you can to keep this seat blue, protect our Senate majority, and power this team to victory.](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3029?t=4&akid=570%2E61531%2E6G8dlo)**

clean_body: | Friend, Over the past few years, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee and its affiliates have made remarkable progress toward fairer redistricting. As we head into the midterm elections this fall, I'm proud to say that the majority of Americans now have either a neutral or net improvement on the fairness of their congressional map. That doesn't mean our work is finished. In fact, the upcoming midterm elections present a unique opportunity to build on the progress we've made at both the state legislative and congressional level, prevent backtracking, and hold the politicians who continue to gerrymander and undermine our democracy accountable. And so, the NDRC has announced its initial 2022 electoral targets -- races that will impact the future of fair redistricting and democracy. I'm asking you to make a donation to help the NDRC invest in supporting those critical races and continue our fight for fair maps. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = I know this has been a long journey. body:
We have to keep Pramila in the fight to stop the worst of climate change.
#
Peter, we need to take action on climate change now.
We're gearing up for a difficult summer in the Pacific Northwest and across this country. Last year, historic high temperatures caused roads to buckle under the stress of heat. Already this year, a water crisis has begun in the Colorado River, part of a “megadrought” that could threaten the water supply for millions of Americans. Storms and wildfires this summer could threaten the safety of millions more.
**There is little time left to prevent a climate catastrophe.** Pramila is on the front lines of this fight, introducing the Climate Resilience Workforce Act to invest in a skilled workforce that can respond to these destructive impacts. We have to pass bold solutions like this bill and others like it as soon as possible.
[**Can you chip in $3 to support Pramila's advocacy to fight the climate crisis? To stand up to fossil fuel companies, their lobbyists, and their corporate PACs, it will take a movement of us working together.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14431?refcode=em20220622-1368&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1368%2E420207%2EWlhC7R)

We have a long way to go to end our reliance on fossil fuels, scale up clean and renewable energy, and transform our society into one that's ready to stop climate change.
**Pramila is committed to leading our efforts.** The bold changes she's advocating for in the House of Representatives are not just transformative, they're absolutely necessary if we're going to be able to address this crisis.

clean_body: We have to keep Pramila in the fight to stop the worst of climate change. Peter, we need to take action on climate change now. We're gearing up for a difficult summer in the Pacific Northwest and across this country. Last year, historic high temperatures caused roads to buckle under the stress of heat. Already this year, a water crisis has begun in the Colorado River, part of a “megadrought” that could threaten the water supply for millions of Americans. Storms and wildfires this summer could threaten the safety of millions more. There is little time left to prevent a climate catastrophe. Pramila is on the front lines of this fight, introducing the Climate Resilience Workforce Act to invest in a skilled workforce that can respond to these destructive impacts. We have to pass bold solutions like this bill and others like it as soon as possible. We have a long way to go to end our reliance on fossil fuels, scale up clean and renewable energy, and transform our society into one that's ready to stop climate change. Pramila is committed to leading our efforts. The bold changes she's advocating for in the House of Representatives are not just transformative, they're absolutely necessary if we're going to be able to address this crisis. In solidarity, Team Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

Dear Neighbor,

You are invited to a special fundraising event for Charity Barry for Congress on Thursday, June 30th. For the first time in Wisconsin, the acclaimed one-man show, [The American Soldier](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016HHnj4GSF2CGFK0jjpvd0O8WAUOdZhdyFjEKEFIP402-3upGefITa1WiMQ7dgJolm-nelB3S21ofVD1bmAz-sv9lHBN_8jzxdkv-Kdf9MiSG-6swIg8D_udJ6AvNoXC5J3gHzI70VB1MZ3QOFlO_1DIghgWO86RXsWunG19BOnGT7tigKZOVr1rbUBmzMb_4hkunNdtGbJ0=&c=SKngpEZvwD_OMUYzd03co6dRD3ki3xc-VS4wMeo41HOUypBzSItKhQ==&ch=mx66u6-M9IcqeZPfKVbX174rhLited_HZP8G-MGbzEwpEfbG-omkvg==), will be performed in Madison. Please see the details below. There is no better way to celebrate the upcoming 4th of July than to honor our veterans. Please RSVP today as seats are limited. Thank you. - Friends of Charity Barry.

"The American Soldier is based and inspired by real stories and letters written by veterans and their families from the American Revolution through the current conflicts in Iraq and Afghanistan. It reveals the struggles American soldiers face at war and their internal struggles to come back home. The show strives to help us understand how and why it is so difficult for men and women in the armed services to re-enter our civilian life when they come back home. Its goal is to honor our veterans and thank their families for their immense sacrifice to our country." Fellow patriot,

Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For a long time, it worked.

But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it. The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better.

Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs.

Let me be clear: The Republican Party welcomes anyone who shares our values. My friend Monica De La Cruz knows that, too. clean_body: Everyone will be watching to see if we stack up. | | | Hi Peter, In just eight days, we’re facing one of the biggest tests of our campaign yet. The Federal Election Commission fundraising deadline is at midnight on June 30. Why does it matter so much? Well, after that, we have to report everything that our campaign has raised in the last three months — and it will be publicly available on the FEC website. That means everybody, from reporters, to potential voters, to Mark Green and his campaign, will be looking to see how we stack up. They’ll be looking to see if there are enough people in this movement to even come close to competing with a self-funding millionaire backed by corporate PAC money like Mark Green. Right now, to be honest, we are behind where we need to be. The last few months have been tough for our digital fundraising, and the timing couldn’t be worse as we try to put together a major organizing effort all across the 7th District. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Peter, we wouldn’t ask if this wasn’t terribly important. In order to send Odessa to Congress to fight for all of us, to advocate for Medicare for All + a Green New Deal, to make sure that working people have a shot in this country, we HAVE to have a strong fundraising quarter. That’s what’s at stake when we send emails like this one. Thank you for your support – even just reading emails like this and keeping up to date means you’re part of this team. clean_body: I love my family more than anything. So when the media and my opponents went after them – that was too far. | Fellow American, The media knew the truth, but they still printed the story. Democrats and the media are trying to create a fake controversy with my campaign because the economy is a mess and it's the Democrats' fault. Since they can't win on the issues, they are coming after my family and my children. That's a step too far. Fellow American, I knew this race could get ugly, but I never thought they'd bring my family into it. Many people avoid politics because of the nasty things that are said and done. I knew what I signed up for when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, but I thought it was worth the risk if I could help get America back on track. The fact that they are bringing my children into the race is absolutely unacceptable. Come after me all you want, but leave my family out of it. But let me be clear: even this despicable level of gutter politics is not going to break my resolve. As the Prophet Isaiah said, no weapon formed against me shall prosper! When things get tough in life, sometimes it seems like giving up is the easiest way out. But I've never been a quitter. In fact, I dig deeper and work even harder when I'm challenged. Fellow American, I need to know if you're with me today. Your digital signature will let me know you've got my back, and it will send a signal to the media that we're sick of their activism reporting. Thanks for standing with me. In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=038f13517a0e4e1281d99922c259d513&_e=RpKBDamx7UBgk1tb9aiHSqUALwaRtwfbioeEZN3X5EKltz8vhwpLg6hbYrn808ke64KYnIl6q-bHHNPh-_aBQRb6CyRFNw9WumJwQXeWF2q0ibSHKxxUHe-EKnt-UoozJ-C6TFwQwCxKnRpUIF0-thyTWHEq8m3OkqKt6MlErwaCdVPX9Sd80xsf2DY3Kn-AjZGGphqn8S8iNuR98CedX3uTIsFuvC7jMEvfin4LRfR-AV0G7v_7JzY-61NL3F-LB0NkCjjSkcyb0cY3LcWeHje7Jp5AKhmyh4ogpztqvrCZ3I2BqDN6s15qN1sPbQf48DH8EFGwBDV9cIw9IRt_dfVosLS-Ld9UQ2FLGINGtPYVa31c913tt_vedG78meJe2Byl3J00pe8cQX56jiEuaZtvxc2F3qRRjD6Cu4ZIfLY%3D)

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=038f13517a0e4e1281d99922c259d513&_e=RpKBDamx7UBgk1tb9aiHSqUALwaRtwfbioeEZN3X5EKltz8vhwpLg6hbYrn808ke64KYnIl6q-bHHNPh-_aBQRb6CyRFNw9WumJwQXeWF2q0ibSHKxxUHe-EKnt-UoozJ-C6TFwQwCxKnRpUIF0-thyTWHEq8m3OkqKt6MlErwaCdVPX9Sd80xsf2DY3Kn-AjZGGphqn8S8iNuR98CedXzekjCyeiZ-KjmcFbg4ShQaTd4m2vIA80H0R_L0kH616BgcNWUUDgTEH_bQDl2oVhfuO_6GJI4wpVdpibzL4AIKQY0f6LDpiOXv5lEGMU-A0KX4zgxRw7ObjgCqKnM3rEXEeEM5COC_sLg7bu64bGmA4zfCN8Buc7F5Y6MNixdzziu2LHd0wj-NOrVYZvLFuR78-VajR7d1Tok5kMu1bAeQ%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=038f13517a0e4e1281d99922c259d513&_e=RpKBDamx7UBgk1tb9aiHSqUALwaRtwfbioeEZN3X5EKltz8vhwpLg6hbYrn808ke64KYnIl6q-bHHNPh-_aBQRb6CyRFNw9WumJwQXeWF2q0ibSHKxxUHe-EKnt-UoozJ-C6TFwQwCxKnRpUIF0-thyTWHEq8m3OkqKt6MlErwaCdVPX9Sd80xsf2DY3Kn-AjZGGphqn8S8iNuR98CedX3BeFRKp4MlOfOzfYLepxefTi71e4lH_r8GbE_JBt4dhFdjRbiffSOk-CdFHxlU9xhzX1tDC4jIpVH_zO7VVFCUIt729QJ2N8KR5l0FL5lpCXiNVxqqOWQIgfQ9YNcJDPQ8pMlqt97ffmcWrC7gaa6mrp3pfUVJgNYoQBFFriyo72pabqOGg_F5Qxp-s4Fjji8N8fKxR2Obr3-EN6ZnRZ7Q%3D)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

name: Jeremy Parkin
subject: Your last chance to join our June sessions!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Whether you are an experienced organizer or looking to get more involved with our campaign for the first time, these sessions are for you.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220622-3127-header&t=1&akid=3127%2E2526796%2EEnsFNA)
We’ve had an incredible response to our Summer Organizing Trainings this month — and tomorrow’s the last session!
[I hope you’ll join us tomorrow for a discussion on the U.S. Congress and how you can influence your elected officials.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14649?source=em20220622-3127&utm_source=em20220622-3127&t=2&akid=3127%2E2526796%2EEnsFNA)
Here are the details:
[Team AOC Summer Session: Organizing Trainings!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14649?source=em20220622-3127&utm_source=em20220622-3127&t=3&akid=3127%2E2526796%2EEnsFNA)

_The U.S. Congress and How You Can Influence Your Elected Officials_
Tomorrow, June 23 at 7:00 PM ET / 4:00 PM PT**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14649?source=em20220622-3127&utm_source=em20220622-3127&t=4&akid=3127%2E2526796%2EEnsFNA)**
---
These trainings are virtual and will be conducted via Zoom so you can join from anywhere in the country! And they’re designed for everyone, whether you are an experienced organizer or a supporter looking to get more involved with our campaign for the first time. After the session, we will provide a number of next steps and ways you can take action.
Since there’s been so much excitement around these sessions, we’re already planning a few additional similar-style trainings for later this summer, so stay tuned!
I hope to see you at the last June summer session training tomorrow!
In solidarity,
Jeremy Parkin
Field Director, Team AOC

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate. | | | | | | | Paid for by Friends of Chuck Morse | | | Friends of Chuck Morse | | PO Box 106 North Salem, NH 03073 | You received this email because you signed up on our website or made a purchase from us.

| Join the Democratic National Committee, Chair Jaime Harrison, DNC Secretary Jason Rae, and the DNC LGBTQ Caucus Chair Earl Fowlkes to celebrate Pride Month! This month, we celebrate love, self-expression, and the freedom to be one’s authentic self. The LGBTQ+ movement is full of remarkable, everyday people who have the audacity to assert their freedom. name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Will you read this whole email? It’s important.
body:
#
Peter,
Since this is a grassroots-powered organization, we want to be transparent with you about where we’re at on our fundraising so far this month. Here are our numbers as of this morning, compared to last month:
**Time Period** | **Amount Raised**
---|---
May | $136,263
June | $74,077
**Difference** | **\- $62,186**
**As you can see, we’re quite a bit behind where we were at this point last month.** We’re working every single day to transform the Democratic Party from the inside out. While the DCCC backs out-of-touch incumbents, we’re fighting to help elect more leaders like AOC, Cori Bush, and Rashida Tlaib.
We’re up against the political establishment in both the Democratic and Republican Parties, which is why grassroots contributions from supporters like you are so important. We’ve gone up against corporate-backed incumbents and won — but in order for that to continue we really need to catch up on our fundraising this month.
[Will you make your first contribution right now to help us catch up on fundraising this month? If a bunch of people chip in even $3, then we can make significant progress on these numbers today.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110802?refcode=em20220622-23970&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110802?refcode=em20220622-23970&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-)**
Look, we’re not going to send you any terrifying, DCCC-style “the sky is falling” emails. There is no reason to kiss all hope goodbye. And we don’t have any generous donors to QUADRUPLE MATCH your donation.
But, we will politely ask you to contribute if you can afford it, so we can keep our work going and keep providing critical organizing help and other campaign services to our Justice Democrats running for office.
[ Please contribute today. Every single contribution will make a difference in helping us reach our fundraising goal before the end of the quarter.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110802?refcode=em20220622-23970&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-)
Thank you for your solidarity,
Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-) and your state public health department.
---

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220622-23970-footer&t=24&refcode2=23970_1203867_1llza-&akid=23970%2E1203867%2E1llza-)**
---

body:
I love my family more than anything. So when the media and my opponents went after them – that was too far. |
---
Fellow American,

The media knew the truth, but they still printed the story.

Democrats and the media are trying to create a fake controversy with my campaign because the economy is a mess and it's the Democrats' fault. Since they can't win on the issues, they are coming after my family and my children. _**That's a step too far.**_

Fellow American, I knew this race could get ugly, but I never thought they'd bring my family into it.

**[Please watch the interview I did over the weekend at the Faith and Freedom Coalition where I addressed these attacks directly:](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=a20dfdd9075a47ffafabd6f63f5aed19&_e=wTlcr6l98b7vZkDSRVOGa-SOBQzB2EBaml1OjZKvU1F9oMhQwfr56D4Fzkweq4lTITSHJTScFH5LnPWzrp0md9eIGYDXRCrhVm9yKWzMw9BDzN37X68KDnAwu9ik1cdVGKUJosFTaopuepjSgbu3ZzSPdOed4cun-QUbIMotRxDp3Kgqka0k6UpK8dHXvPvdu89fyG0BsZKr_1BnnRe8_ky1DzIIureEvaqw9k07vOglZVm83lSYEFCoLAsAeJFZDi5GEF3EYJFUNxhTmYYiy5pF9LmHWFeax8N_GK5RoiARxXMD8KQWAr3dwwKeFnq_RMeiJzpJ4wSpV35RGWT48mykc6lS76I9pdrzrP5je9GxHct0_SgXnbA2KW5DC-N9_SdSWw2pxDTqo05KEZrgwjxw5ZfC48jUGJnuz93v99D8ul4oxSKNKc_HMKfNoRLt0Ks4RK8Do_UVIdPYwbz3DVOoSuZC2HXqhZLRZPk9hkaSkKeyhmCWQc4KGFEPIZH7j0eY6DE1JJZHESEUX6USPmclc3Om-y5QkXTKpdP1wC1SfsJhfpv78PG6s9V1vNTiLTbN2JXX3nMg7qxr_09-Hf7W2YY4vBK4oNbnzcHVdrw%3D)**

Many people avoid politics because of the nasty things that are said and done. I knew what I signed up for when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, but I thought it was worth the risk if I could help get America back on track.

**The fact that they are bringing my children into the race is absolutely unacceptable. Come after me all you want, but leave my family out of it.**

**But let me be clear: even this despicable level of gutter politics is not going to break my resolve. As the Prophet Isaiah said, no weapon formed against me shall prosper!**

When things get tough in life, sometimes it seems like giving up is the easiest way out. _**But I've never been a quitter. In fact, I dig deeper and work even harder when I'm challenged.**_

Fellow American, I need to know if you're with me today. **[Will you add your name to our Pledge of Support to let me know you're standing with me as Democrats and the media attack me and my family?](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=a20dfdd9075a47ffafabd6f63f5aed19&_e=wTlcr6l98b7vZkDSRVOGa-SOBQzB2EBaml1OjZKvU1F9oMhQwfr56D4Fzkweq4lTITSHJTScFH5LnPWzrp0md9eIGYDXRCrhVm9yKWzMw9BDzN37X68KDnAwu9ik1cdVGKUJosFTaopuepjSgbu3ZzSPdOed4cun-QUbIMotRxDp3Kgqka0k6UpK8dHXvPvdu89fyG0BsZKr_1BnnRe8_ky1DzIIureEvaqw9k07vOglZVm83lSYEFCoLAsAeJFZDi5GEF3EYJFUNxhTmYYiy5pF9LmHWFeax8N_GK5RoiARxXMD8KQWAr3dwwKeFnq_RMeiJzpJ4wSpV35RGWT48mykc6lS76I9pdrzrP5je9GxHct0_SgXnbA2KW5DC-N9_SdSWw2pxDTqo05KEZrgwsUsbsG4N15S2Qy9_z4n4yLYHmHYfN8w8qxF_m1_sQfghku4ziFX0Sd0MAP-mafZZzIABsdn_YlwK8DWo5D9mMM_zTtpjROoYPA6NE5dyUQmwldp4MTODFtvTO4XS8_ldgZ-JG8ctupLtL7xHex2njYuSlQnMxaFVXgnxY8s96wP13Q6tUSVpncTikPKpr0cqHzVHXWP3Y6BJrw9pvfeEOM%3D)**

Your digital signature will let me know you've got my back, and it will send a signal to the media that we're sick of their activism reporting.

_Thanks for standing with me._

clean_body: I love my family more than anything. So when the media and my opponents went after them – that was too far. | Fellow American, The media knew the truth, but they still printed the story. Democrats and the media are trying to create a fake controversy with my campaign because the economy is a mess and it's the Democrats' fault. Since they can't win on the issues, they are coming after my family and my children. That's a step too far. Fellow American, I knew this race could get ugly, but I never thought they'd bring my family into it. Many people avoid politics because of the nasty things that are said and done. I knew what I signed up for when I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, but I thought it was worth the risk if I could help get America back on track. The fact that they are bringing my children into the race is absolutely unacceptable. Come after me all you want, but leave my family out of it. But let me be clear: even this despicable level of gutter politics is not going to break my resolve. As the Prophet Isaiah said, no weapon formed against me shall prosper! When things get tough in life, sometimes it seems like giving up is the easiest way out. But I've never been a quitter. In fact, I dig deeper and work even harder when I'm challenged. Fellow American, I need to know if you're with me today. Your digital signature will let me know you've got my back, and it will send a signal to the media that we're sick of their activism reporting. Thanks for standing with me. Sincerely, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but ._

# __Help Team Marter in the Final Push!__
---
| _**Jim Marter** **here**_ _-_ Here we are, 6 days until Primary Election Day! At this stage in the game, we are in our absolute final push. Once the next 6 days are past us, there is no do over. This is, what I truly believe, our last chance to change the course of this disastrous administration. Let's not be those who sit on the sidelines and wonder if they could have helped.

---
|
## **_Option 1: Walk_**
There is no act greater than connecting with your voters directly. I've knocked on countless doors and connected with the voters and heard their issues directly. This is why going door to door is incredibly important in a race like mine. As a Team Marter representative, we would love for you to represent us on the ground! **Text Christa at (614) 561-6441** saying "**_I'll Walk_** " to get all set up. It might sound a little daunting - but it's actually pretty fun and can be very illuminating. Better yet...do it with a friend!
---
|
## **_Option 2: Call_**
We will bring the phone numbers and talking points- you bring the phone! We need your help more than ever to highlight why Jim is the right choice for IL-14. **T****ext Christa at (614) 561-6441** saying "**_I'll Call_** " and we will get you started ASAP with helping Team Marter.

---
## **_Option 3: Drive_**
This one seems silly, but during early voting through election day, reach out to that friend of yours whom might be on the fence and get them off! We need to get _everyone_ to the polls to make sure we run a true conservative fighter this November and REPLACE Lauren Underwood!

---
|
## **_Option 4: Donate_**
Running an operation as vast as mine, you simply need funds coming in to sustain the momentum. Lord knows we have that momentum in spades! If you can't Walk, Post, or Call - please consider Donating to Team Marter. As I've promised on the campaign trail, I will be a faithful steward of your tax dollars - I will do the same for your donations to my campaign. We have an election to win, folks! Click the Donate button below and pledge whatever amount you can afford to spare - I so appreciate it!

---

|
## **__In Closing:__**
I've said it many times before - but thank you. Thank you for believing in me and my team. Thank you for donating when I have called upon you. Thank you for any help you can lend in the next few days as we make our final Push! Together, we'll restore true conservative leadership to our communities and homes! God bless these great United States of America and God bless you! **Let's win this!** **_~Jim Marter_**

Fellow American,

My name is Rod Dorilás and I’m a candidate for Congress in Florida’s 22ND Congressional District.

My opponent isn’t too terribly famous or even a household name. But she’s a Democrat who I’m not convinced still believes that the American Dream is alive.

**Why am I reaching out to you today, you might be thinking?** Well, I'm having a hard time raisng funds for my congressional campaign.

With out an immediate influx of cash, I may have to exit my race. So in a Hail Mary attempt to stave off that possibility, **[I thought I'd send around my launch video to folks like you to see if you'd consider chipping in a few bucks to help me save my campaign from floundering](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=aaabc6f214f84e7c89eac4be6752da6d&_e=RHC4om6PjcL16eILsM051WSogdhGJpUgttMetamgNKKOG4O1NDeA1kgz8VyiXeejT0jx_WWiTQEI3eF4t8HNL7P48sdcc2BLHow3wMTETRAfJkM_BaTDnLhXCbOdXtdD4w3LofcFwnskvuj2vmEjrn6Pmbncx8-EUffBf6TzY3BulYhAdyMlP5aO6ZeXrzU8Bpqk49qG1PiE4qMYmVob2VeWNS89zjQThgaJEgE_eIBAXZJldED3XXsSE5768Pwzw4DU62H31PoSDeMDyyb4kWvwXrCc4HFvm78P1NJZwK73Dxv2_oVEVAuBUgRCheYBtZTOyHds5wRl7izmhX9r0aAluN1TQTkwOpdeDcAC-28JMsh2Q6bOAo22s9TQQsqCeqvu-8BSh5_HK6JH4TivatrM4R24pNruSdN0jfoEy4Ir-qGI3BwkD4LlCgcZXw9-Q9zKH9qSCsGVMk730nN8yKxLOQ6CKzz40rMlAVp_H_o%3D)**.

**[All I'm asking of you today is that you please take a 10-30 seconds to watch my introduction video that I recorded several months ago and believe is worth the watch](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=aaabc6f214f84e7c89eac4be6752da6d&_e=RHC4om6PjcL16eILsM051WSogdhGJpUgttMetamgNKKOG4O1NDeA1kgz8VyiXeejT0jx_WWiTQEI3eF4t8HNL7P48sdcc2BLHow3wMTETRAfJkM_BaTDnLhXCbOdXtdD4w3LofcFwnskvuj2vmEjrn6Pmbncx8-EUffBf6TzY3BulYhAdyMlP5aO6ZeXrzU8Bpqk49qG1PiE4qMYmVob2VeWNS89zjQThgaJEgE_eIBAXZJldED3XXsSE5768Pwzw4DU62H31PoSDeMDyyb4kV3nufx9_RfltDzSVBbsMhkPV27tZwfeJ6uXR8Llm86WPwlYvvKL2vgSqUav0y6nEa-EYXfdLz4y_ZDpPxg9eNL3ubnh7i-KTQL9VCvIv2Q85IB8B_qGaUK-rDi42AFlzp5kqhAQq8CkoawrawSgTsW35Pq7Y_GbpHr_X-DSUh2pRin3h1C0LnhwHK0Jvb6wNi6odAeYck3Sv2IXYB22KxI%3D)**.

As a first generation American, I thank god every day the American Dream is alive and well.

[**WATCH MY LAUNCH VIDEO >> **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=aaabc6f214f84e7c89eac4be6752da6d&_e=RHC4om6PjcL16eILsM051WSogdhGJpUgttMetamgNKKOG4O1NDeA1kgz8VyiXeejT0jx_WWiTQEI3eF4t8HNL7P48sdcc2BLHow3wMTETRAfJkM_BaTDnLhXCbOdXtdD4w3LofcFwnskvuj2vmEjrn6Pmbncx8-EUffBf6TzY3BulYhAdyMlP5aO6ZeXrzU8Bpqk49qG1PiE4qMYmVob2VeWNS89zjQThgaJEgE_eIBAXZJldED3XXsSE5768Pwzw4DU62H31PoSDeMDyyb4kVSME2Ptm1h2aBkBRU161aVvqMhYQX1ajtNDVI8L8uhbUoMLtdtT8IK3fkJKNug26AA406CtDuah2nmCTiefaVQZCmmr3eH_RsBxXBcObODwL6KGaq6N6uK9e4AWm6glQDcglGB8-1naj4tdAzDDH5k83o2aCINYKfnW4LRg4brp4SdJFTJ1uccNrKtY2gBdBqnpGyzE9q9z3aS0g3G3i3o%3D)
A few key facts about myself that you may find informative:
* I’m a first generation American, the son of two Haitian immigrants. **My parents immigrated to the United States to pick crops** in order to provide for our family.
* At 17, I enlisted in the Navy and served six years planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles.
* I attended Syracuse University Law School on the G.I. Bill.
* Following graduation, **I worked for the Department of Commerce under President Trump** (the honor of a lifetime!).

[**WATCH MY LAUNCH VIDEO TODAY >> **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=aaabc6f214f84e7c89eac4be6752da6d&_e=RHC4om6PjcL16eILsM051WSogdhGJpUgttMetamgNKKOG4O1NDeA1kgz8VyiXeejT0jx_WWiTQEI3eF4t8HNL7P48sdcc2BLHow3wMTETRAfJkM_BaTDnLhXCbOdXtdD4w3LofcFwnskvuj2vmEjrn6Pmbncx8-EUffBf6TzY3BulYhAdyMlP5aO6ZeXrzU8Bpqk49qG1PiE4qMYmVob2VeWNS89zjQThgaJEgE_eIBAXZJldED3XXsSE5768Pwzw4DU62H31PoSDeMDyyb4kbV90MgKD2rPl3yi4UBgvMsqhJeObU17mvn6J0ft2uMUKmAoVGxjYVlyL_4hiNvW8NW_hgFpKT8z_jFm71cpnbWxvEGHz-vR3_SchSGEp15cEpcOTCxkZftBeN8TkCPLsJLjnxHv3schzqkF4UId-0OlWVuEzIbb589nSNTIph-YDnzJwKQ_UHTeVYReKDqrPu_EjayGFc9nXXIBBfygFrA%3D)

I have to be level-headed about what we decide to do next, but I**can tell you that without adequate cash in the bank I may have to step back from running for Congress.** While that is the last thing that I want to do with just some 60ish days before the primary, I am going to need your help urgently if I have any shot at becoming the **4th elected Black Republican in Congress come next January.**

**[Would you do me a great personal favor by chipping in $4 to help me get my fundraising for the month back on track?](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=aaabc6f214f84e7c89eac4be6752da6d&_e=RHC4om6PjcL16eILsM051WSogdhGJpUgttMetamgNKKOG4O1NDeA1kgz8VyiXeejT0jx_WWiTQEI3eF4t8HNL7P48sdcc2BLHow3wMTETRAfJkM_BaTDnLhXCbOdXtdD4w3LofcFwnskvuj2vmEjrn6Pmbncx8-EUffBf6TzY3BulYhAdyMlP5aO6ZeXrzU8Bpqk49qG1PiE4qMYmVob2VeWNS89zjQThgaJEgE_eIBAXZJldED3XXsSE5768Pwzw4DU62H31PoSDeMDyyb4kTjFWQAnnWnCV37j8jlNoFDRfUH_s8EkCCWNBdu1wGbKvWP21ifzjpArchvp9o0oIaq5YhDgzS5_mCMv1aNhQtOoEwZq0L4HXNs_3WUMpNUfuYLLVIP7woN756zfF7alubBKwHfGkKGDV7zsuMQY7oYuzrFYHOeFPuq4ZyXlfujRy8raxtXt7y2HdbebZS0_XFOmSQIMimNDGyEdesiv4RA%3D)**

With 435 members, the U.S. House is bigger than any one person. However, my own personal story has taught me that just about anything in America is possible if you work hard enough. I believe that maxim still rings true today, and that’s why I’m asking you to send a few dollars to my campaign if you can.

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=405%2E5257348%2E5VPh9k)
Hi Derek! It’s Lexi, Adam’s coolest, favorite, most successful child. (I wrote more but they made me shorten it, regrettably)
In true oldest child fashion, I've already planned the ultimate birthday surprise for my dad, and it's iconic. His 62nd birthday is today if you didn’t already know (apologies if his age gets redacted from this email... that's classified).
Anyway, the surprise involves this photo of him I found that looks like it was taken right out of a 90s sitcom like _Friends_ , or more accurately, _Seinfeld_ — imagine a guest star on that show who's storyline involves debating the "hardships" of being a vegan Jew visiting New York City with George Costanza, again... iconic!
From a place of love and total fashion superiority, I’ve been telling my dad for years he needs a wardrobe makeover. He’s still wearing Abercrombie & Fitch shirts, which at this point are honestly becoming vintage and maybe even.... cool? (don't tell him I said that).
However - that’s when I got a perfect idea for his birthday! His very own limited edition ✨retro shirt✨ please, please, hold your applause.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1058?refcode=AU_ABS_CL_MER_GEN_AC_20220622_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=405%2E5257348%2E5VPh9k)
[BUY A RETRO SHIRT](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1058?refcode=AU_ABS_CL_MER_GEN_AC_20220622_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=405%2E5257348%2E5VPh9k)
---
It’s already flying off the racks. Oh, and while you're checking out my awesome design, might as well pick up some of the other fun merch on my dad's store too (c'mon, support our democracy people).
I can’t wait to see his reaction when he sees people wearing these on the street — he’s gonna flip lol.
**[You can buy one now by clicking here!](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1058?refcode=AU_ABS_CL_MER_GEN_AC_20220622_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=405%2E5257348%2E5VPh9k)**
Hope you like the shirts! P.S. Dad, if you see this email, _no you didn’t_. Sorry, I forgot to ask permission! Happy Birthday!!
Sincerely,
Lexi
150 E. Olive Ave., Suite 208 Burbank CA, 91502

Peter, there are so many different things going on in our country right now that sometimes it’s just easier to tune them out and pray for the best than to take the time to understand them. Now more than ever, however, it’s important that each one us be engaged members of our democracy, even if it makes our head—and heart—hurt a little bit.

Think of it: rising inflation, sky-high gas prices, rising housing costs, horrific gun violence, divisive court rulings, and a depressing but critically important investigation into the January 6th, 2021 insurrection at the Capitol. It’s exhausting to think that all of it is happening right now in America. It’s understandable why so many Americans are tuning it out as best as they can, but that’s very, very dangerous to do right now. **When reasonable people sit on the sidelines, then the extremists at both ends win. In fact, they’re hoping the normal people check out so they can take over in both political parties and more easily pursue their radical agendas**. Take for example what happened at the Texas Republican Party's Convention on Saturday.
